title.sw: Sessions na kuingia hufanyaje kazi katika PHP?

answer.en: A session lets the server remember a user between pages. Call `session_start()` before any output, store the user id in `$_SESSION`, and clear it on logout. Regenerate the session id after login.
answer.fr: Une session permet au serveur de se souvenir d'un utilisateur entre les pages. Appelez `session_start()` avant toute sortie, stockez l'identifiant dans `$_SESSION` et videz-la à la déconnexion. Régénérez l'identifiant de session après la connexion.
answer.rw: Session ituma seriveri yibuka umukoresha hagati y'impapuro. Hamagara `session_start()` mbere y'ibisohoka byose, bika id y'umukoresha muri `$_SESSION`, uyisibe iyo asohotse. Ongera ukore id nshya ya session nyuma yo kwinjira.
answer.sw: Session humruhusu seva kumkumbuka mtumiaji kati ya kurasa. Ita `session_start()` kabla ya matokeo yoyote, hifadhi kitambulisho cha mtumiaji kwenye `$_SESSION`, na kifute anapotoka. Tengeneza kitambulisho kipya cha session baada ya kuingia.

en: Start: `session_start();` at the very top of every page that needs it.
Protect a page: `if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"])) { header("Location: login.php"); exit; }`
fr: Début : `session_start();` tout en haut de chaque page concernée.
Après vérification du mot de passe : `session_regenerate_id(true); $_SESSION["user_id"] = $id;`
Protéger une page : `if (!isset($_SESSION["user_id"])) { header("Location: login.php"); exit; }`
rw: Tangira: `session_start();` hejuru cyane ya buri paji ibikeneye.
sw: Anza: `session_start();` juu kabisa ya kila ukurasa unaohitaji.

title.en: What is the difference between let, const and var in JavaScript?
title.fr: Quelle différence entre let, const et var en JavaScript ?
title.rw: Itandukaniro rya let, const na var muri JavaScript ni irihe?
title.sw: Tofauti ya let, const na var katika JavaScript ni ipi?

answer.en: `let` declares a variable you can change, `const` declares one that cannot be reassigned, and `var` is the old function-scoped style that is best avoided. Both `let` and `const` are block-scoped (they exist only inside the `{ }` where they are declared).
answer.fr: `let` déclare une variable modifiable, `const` une variable non réassignable et `var` est l'ancien style à portée de fonction, à éviter. `let` et `const` ont une portée de bloc (elles n'existent que dans les `{ }` où elles sont déclarées).
answer.rw: `let` itangaza variable ushobora guhindura, `const` itangaza itongera guhabwa agaciro gashya, naho `var` ni uburyo bwa kera bukorera ku rwego rwa function bukwiye kwirindwa. `let` na `const` bikorera mu `{ }` byatangarijwemo gusa.
answer.sw: `let` hutangaza kigeuzo unachoweza kubadilisha, `const` kisichoweza kupewa thamani mpya, na `var` ni mtindo wa zamani wa wigo wa function unaofaa kuepukwa. `let` na `const` hufanya kazi ndani ya `{ }` zilizotangazwa tu.

en: A `const` array or object can still change inside: `const a = []; a.push(1);` is fine.
Rule of thumb: use `const` by default, `let` when the value must change.
fr: Un tableau ou objet `const` peut changer de contenu : `const a = []; a.push(1);` est valide.
Règle simple : `const` par défaut, `let` quand la valeur doit changer.
rw: Array cyangwa object ya `const` ishobora guhindura ibiyirimo: `const a = []; a.push(1);` ni byiza.
Itegeko ry'ibanze: koresha `const` mbere na mbere, `let` iyo agaciro kagomba guhinduka.
sw: Array au object ya `const` bado inaweza kubadilika ndani: `const a = []; a.push(1);` ni sawa.
Kanuni: tumia `const` kwanza, `let` thamani inapohitaji kubadilika.

title.en: What are functions and arrow functions in JavaScript?
title.fr: Que sont les fonctions et les fonctions fléchées en JavaScript ?
title.rw: Functions na arrow functions muri JavaScript ni iki?
title.sw: Functions na arrow functions katika JavaScript ni nini?

answer.en: A function is a reusable block of code. An arrow function is a shorter way to write one: `const add = (a, b) => a + b;`. Arrow functions are handy as callbacks, and unlike normal functions they do not have their own `this`.
answer.fr: Une fonction est un bloc de code réutilisable. Une fonction fléchée est une écriture plus courte : `const add = (a, b) => a + b;`. Elles sont pratiques comme callbacks et, contrairement aux fonctions classiques, n'ont pas leur propre `this`.
answer.rw: Function ni igice cya code gishobora gukoreshwa kenshi. Arrow function ni uburyo bugufi bwo kuyandika: `const add = (a, b) => a + b;`. Ziba zifite akamaro nka callbacks kandi zitandukanye na function zisanzwe kuko zitagira `this` yazo.
answer.sw: Function ni kipande cha msimbo kinachoweza kutumika tena. Arrow function ni njia fupi ya kuiandika: `const add = (a, b) => a + b;`. Ni muhimu kama callbacks na tofauti na function za kawaida hazina `this` yake yenyewe.

en: Normal: `function add(a, b) { return a + b; }`
Arrow: `const add = (a, b) => a + b;` then `add(2, 3)` returns 5.
One parameter needs no brackets: `const double = x => x * 2;`
Use a block body when you need several lines: `(a, b) => { const s = a + b; return s; }`
fr: Classique : `function add(a, b) { return a + b; }`
Fléchée : `const add = (a, b) => a + b;` puis `add(2, 3)` renvoie 5.
Un seul paramètre sans parenthèses : `const double = x => x * 2;`
Avec plusieurs lignes, utilisez un bloc : `(a, b) => { const s = a + b; return s; }`
rw: Isanzwe: `function add(a, b) { return a + b; }`
Arrow: `const add = (a, b) => a + b;` hanyuma `add(2, 3)` isubiza 5.
Parameter imwe nta makaramu: `const double = x => x * 2;`
Iyo ukeneye imirongo myinshi koresha blok: `(a, b) => { const s = a + b; return s; }`
sw: Ya kawaida: `function add(a, b) { return a + b; }`
Arrow: `const add = (a, b) => a + b;` kisha `add(2, 3)` inarudisha 5.
Parameter moja haihitaji mabano: `const double = x => x * 2;`
Ukihitaji mistari mingi tumia blok: `(a, b) => { const s = a + b; return s; }`

title.en: How do map, filter and reduce work on arrays?
title.fr: Comment fonctionnent map, filter et reduce sur les tableaux ?
title.rw: map, filter na reduce bikora bite kuri array?
title.sw: map, filter na reduce hufanyaje kazi kwenye array?

answer.en: `map` makes a new array by changing every item, `filter` keeps only the items that pass a test, and `reduce` combines all items into one value. None of them change the original array.
answer.fr: `map` crée un nouveau tableau en transformant chaque élément, `filter` garde seulement les éléments qui passent un test et `reduce` combine tous les éléments en une valeur. Aucune ne modifie le tableau d'origine.
answer.rw: `map` ikora array nshya ihindura buri kintu, `filter` igumana ibyatsinze ikizamini gusa, naho `reduce` ihuza ibintu byose mu gaciro kamwe. Nta na kimwe muri byo gihindura array y'umwimerere.
answer.sw: `map` huunda array mpya kwa kubadilisha kila kipengee, `filter` huweka vinavyopita jaribio tu, na `reduce` huunganisha vipengee vyote kuwa thamani moja. Hakuna kati yao kinachobadilisha array asilia.

en: Also: `arr.push(4)` adds, `arr.pop()` removes the last, `arr.find(x => x > 1)` returns the first match.
fr: Aussi : `arr.push(4)` ajoute, `arr.pop()` retire le dernier, `arr.find(x => x > 1)` renvoie le premier résultat.
rw: Kandi: `arr.push(4)` yongeraho, `arr.pop()` ikuraho icya nyuma, `arr.find(x => x > 1)` isubiza icya mbere gihuye.
sw: Pia: `arr.push(4)` huongeza, `arr.pop()` huondoa cha mwisho, `arr.find(x => x > 1)` hurudisha cha kwanza kinacholingana.

title.en: How do I change a web page and react to clicks with JavaScript?
title.fr: Comment modifier une page web et réagir aux clics avec JavaScript ?
title.rw: Nahindura nte paji y'urubuga nkakira ibyo ukanze na JavaScript?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kubadilisha ukurasa wa wavuti na kuitikia mibofyo kwa JavaScript?

answer.en: The DOM is the page as JavaScript sees it. Select an element with `document.querySelector()`, change it, and react to actions with `addEventListener()`. Use `textContent` (not `innerHTML`) for text from users, to avoid injecting code.
answer.fr: Le DOM est la page telle que JavaScript la voit. Sélectionnez un élément avec `document.querySelector()`, modifiez-le et réagissez aux actions avec `addEventListener()`. Utilisez `textContent` (pas `innerHTML`) pour le texte venant des utilisateurs, afin d'éviter l'injection de code.
answer.rw: DOM ni paji nk'uko JavaScript iyibona. Hitamo element ukoresheje `document.querySelector()`, uyihindure, kandi witabire ibikorwa ukoresheje `addEventListener()`. Koresha `textContent` (si `innerHTML`) ku nyandiko ziva ku bakoresha kugira ngo wirinde gushyiramo code mbi.
answer.sw: DOM ni ukurasa kama JavaScript inavyouona. Chagua kipengee kwa `document.querySelector()`, kibadilishe, na uitikie vitendo kwa `addEventListener()`. Tumia `textContent` (si `innerHTML`) kwa maandishi ya watumiaji ili kuepuka kuingiza msimbo.

en: Put the script at the end of the body, or use `defer`, so the elements exist first.
fr: Placez le script en fin de body, ou utilisez `defer`, pour que les éléments existent.
rw: Shyira script ku iherezo rya body, cyangwa ukoreshe `defer`, kugira ngo elements zibanze kubaho.
sw: Weka script mwisho wa body, au tumia `defer`, ili vipengee viwepo kwanza.

title.en: How do I get data from an API with fetch and async/await?
title.fr: Comment récupérer des données d'une API avec fetch et async/await ?
title.rw: Nakura nte amakuru kuri API nkoresheje fetch na async/await?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kupata data kutoka API kwa fetch na async/await?

answer.en: `fetch()` requests data over HTTP and returns a Promise. With `async`/`await` you can write it like normal step-by-step code. Always check `response.ok` and wrap it in `try/catch` because networks fail.
answer.fr: `fetch()` demande des données par HTTP et renvoie une Promise. Avec `async`/`await` vous l'écrivez comme du code séquentiel. Vérifiez toujours `response.ok` et entourez d'un `try/catch`, car les réseaux échouent.
answer.rw: `fetch()` isaba amakuru kuri HTTP ikagarura Promise. Ukoresheje `async`/`await` wayandika nk'code isanzwe ikurikirana. Burigihe genzura `response.ok` ukoreshe `try/catch` kuko imiyoboro ishobora kunanirwa.
answer.sw: `fetch()` huomba data kupitia HTTP na kurudisha Promise. Kwa `async`/`await` unaweza kuiandika kama msimbo wa kawaida wa hatua kwa hatua. Kagua `response.ok` kila mara na tumia `try/catch` kwa sababu mitandao hushindwa.

en: `    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status); const data = await res.json(); console.log(data);`
fr: `    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status); const data = await res.json(); console.log(data);`
rw: `    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status); const data = await res.json(); console.log(data);`
sw: `    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status); const data = await res.json(); console.log(data);`

title.en: What is the difference between == and === in JavaScript?
title.fr: Quelle différence entre == et === en JavaScript ?
title.rw: Itandukaniro rya == na === muri JavaScript ni irihe?
title.sw: Tofauti ya == na === katika JavaScript ni ipi?

sw: sawa mara mbili sawa mara tatu

answer.en: `==` compares after converting types (so `0 == "0"` is true), while `===` compares value and type without converting (so `0 === "0"` is false). Use `===` almost always; it avoids surprises.
answer.fr: `==` compare après conversion de types (donc `0 == "0"` est vrai), tandis que `===` compare valeur et type sans conversion (donc `0 === "0"` est faux). Utilisez presque toujours `===` ; cela évite les surprises.
answer.rw: `==` igereranya nyuma yo guhindura ubwoko (bityo `0 == "0"` ni ukuri), naho `===` igereranya agaciro n'ubwoko bidahinduwe (bityo `0 === "0"` ni ikinyoma). Koresha `===` hafi buri gihe; birinda gutungurwa.
answer.sw: `==` hulinganisha baada ya kubadilisha aina (hivyo `0 == "0"` ni kweli), wakati `===` hulinganisha thamani na aina bila kubadilisha (hivyo `0 === "0"` ni uongo). Tumia `===` karibu kila mara; huepusha mshangao.

title.en: What is an IP address?
title.fr: Qu'est-ce qu'une adresse IP ?
title.rw: Aderesi ya IP ni iki?
title.sw: Anwani ya IP ni nini?

answer.en: An IP address is a number that identifies a device on a network so data can reach it. IPv4 looks like `192.168.1.10` (four numbers from 0 to 255); IPv6 is longer and written in hexadecimal. DHCP usually hands out addresses automatically.
answer.fr: Une adresse IP est un numéro qui identifie un appareil sur un réseau pour que les données l'atteignent. IPv4 ressemble à `192.168.1.10` (quatre nombres de 0 à 255) ; IPv6 est plus longue et écrite en hexadécimal. Le DHCP attribue généralement les adresses automatiquement.
answer.rw: Aderesi ya IP ni umubare umenyesha igikoresho kuri network kugira ngo amakuru amugereho. IPv4 isa na `192.168.1.10` (imibare ine kuva kuri 0 kugeza 255); IPv6 ni ndende yandikwa muri hexadecimal. DHCP akenshi itanga aderesi mu buryo bwikora.
answer.sw: Anwani ya IP ni namba inayotambulisha kifaa kwenye mtandao ili data ifike kwake. IPv4 inaonekana kama `192.168.1.10` (namba nne kutoka 0 hadi 255); IPv6 ni ndefu na huandikwa kwa hexadecimal. DHCP kwa kawaida hutoa anwani kiotomatiki.

en: Your public IP is the one the internet sees, given by your internet provider.
Find yours on Windows: run `ipconfig`; on Linux or Mac: `ip a` or `ifconfig`.
fr: Votre IP publique est celle vue par Internet, attribuée par votre fournisseur d'accès.
Trouvez la vôtre sous Windows : `ipconfig` ; sous Linux ou Mac : `ip a` ou `ifconfig`.
rw: Intera z'ibanga (mu rugo no mu biro): `10.x.x.x`, `172.16.x.x`–`172.31.x.x`, `192.168.x.x`.
IP rusange ni iyo murandasi ibona, itangwa n'utanga murandasi.
Menya iyawe kuri Windows: `ipconfig`; kuri Linux cyangwa Mac: `ip a` cyangwa `ifconfig`.
sw: IP yako ya umma ni ile inayoonekana na mtandao, inayotolewa na mtoa huduma wa intaneti.
Pata yako kwenye Windows: `ipconfig`; kwenye Linux au Mac: `ip a` au `ifconfig`.

title.en: What is DNS and what does it do?
title.fr: Qu'est-ce que le DNS et à quoi sert-il ?
title.rw: DNS ni iki kandi ikora iki?
title.sw: DNS ni nini na hufanya nini?

answer.en: DNS (Domain Name System) works like the internet's phone book: it turns a name such as `example.com` into the IP address computers actually use. If DNS fails, sites may not open by name even though the connection itself works.
answer.fr: Le DNS (Domain Name System) fonctionne comme l'annuaire d'Internet : il transforme un nom comme `example.com` en adresse IP réellement utilisée par les ordinateurs. Si le DNS échoue, les sites peuvent ne pas s'ouvrir par leur nom alors que la connexion fonctionne.
answer.rw: DNS (Domain Name System) ikora nk'igitabo cy'inimero za telefoni cya murandasi: ihindura izina nka `example.com` aderesi ya IP mudasobwa zikoresha koko. Iyo DNS inaniwe, imbuga zishobora kudafunguka ku izina nubwo uguhuza gukora.
answer.sw: DNS (Domain Name System) hufanya kazi kama kitabu cha simu cha intaneti: hubadilisha jina kama `example.com` kuwa anwani ya IP ambayo kompyuta hutumia kweli. DNS ikishindwa, tovuti zinaweza kutofunguka kwa jina ingawa muunganisho unafanya kazi.

en: Test: run `nslookup example.com` and see whether an address comes back.
If `ping 8.8.8.8` works but names fail, the problem is probably DNS.
Try another DNS server in your network settings (your provider's, or a public one) and restart the router.
fr: Test : `nslookup example.com` et regardez si une adresse revient.
Si `ping 8.8.8.8` marche mais pas les noms, le problème est probablement le DNS.
Essayez un autre serveur DNS dans les réglages réseau (celui du fournisseur ou un public) et redémarrez le routeur.
rw: Gerageza: `nslookup example.com` urebe niba aderesi igaruka.
Niba `ping 8.8.8.8` ikora ariko amazina ntakore, ikibazo ni DNS.
Gerageza indi seriveri ya DNS mu igenamiterere rya network ukore restart ya router.
sw: Jaribu: `nslookup example.com` na uone kama anwani inarudi.
Ikiwa `ping 8.8.8.8` inafanya kazi lakini majina hayafanyi, tatizo huenda ni DNS.
Jaribu seva nyingine ya DNS kwenye mipangilio ya mtandao na uwashe tena router.

title.en: What are the 7 layers of the OSI model?
title.fr: Quelles sont les 7 couches du modèle OSI ?
title.rw: Ibice 7 by'icyitegererezo cya OSI ni ibihe?
title.sw: Tabaka 7 za modeli ya OSI ni zipi?

answer.en: The OSI model describes networking in seven layers, from bottom to top: 1 Physical, 2 Data Link, 3 Network, 4 Transport, 5 Session, 6 Presentation, 7 Application. Each layer does one job and serves the layer above it.
answer.fr: Le modèle OSI décrit les réseaux en sept couches, de bas en haut : 1 Physique, 2 Liaison de données, 3 Réseau, 4 Transport, 5 Session, 6 Présentation, 7 Application. Chaque couche remplit une tâche et sert la couche au-dessus.
answer.rw: Icyitegererezo cya OSI gisobanura network mu bice birindwi, kuva hasi ujya hejuru: 1 Physical, 2 Data Link, 3 Network, 4 Transport, 5 Session, 6 Presentation, 7 Application. Buri gice gikora umurimo umwe kandi gifasha igice kiri hejuru yacyo.
answer.sw: Modeli ya OSI inaelezea mtandao katika tabaka saba, kutoka chini hadi juu: 1 Physical, 2 Data Link, 3 Network, 4 Transport, 5 Session, 6 Presentation, 7 Application. Kila tabaka lina kazi moja na linalihudumia tabaka la juu yake.

en: Layer 1: cables and signals. Layer 2: MAC addresses and switches. Layer 3: IP addresses and routers.
Layer 4: TCP and UDP, ports. Layers 5–7: sessions, data formats and applications (HTTP, DNS, email).
Memory aid from the top: All People Seem To Need Data Processing.
The simpler TCP/IP model groups them into four layers: Link, Internet, Transport, Application.
fr: Couche 1 : câbles et signaux. Couche 2 : adresses MAC et commutateurs. Couche 3 : adresses IP et routeurs.
Couche 4 : TCP et UDP, ports. Couches 5–7 : sessions, formats de données et applications (HTTP, DNS, e-mail).
Aide-mémoire depuis le haut : All People Seem To Need Data Processing.
Le modèle TCP/IP plus simple les regroupe en quatre couches : Liaison, Internet, Transport, Application.
rw: Igice 1: insinga n'ibimenyetso. Igice 2: aderesi za MAC na switch. Igice 3: aderesi za IP na router.
Igice 4: TCP na UDP, ports. Ibice 5–7: sessions, imiterere y'amakuru na porogaramu (HTTP, DNS, imeri).
Uburyo bwo kwibuka uhereye hejuru: All People Seem To Need Data Processing.
Icyitegererezo cya TCP/IP cyoroshye kibishyira mu bice bine: Link, Internet, Transport, Application.
sw: Tabaka 1: nyaya na ishara. Tabaka 2: anwani za MAC na switch. Tabaka 3: anwani za IP na router.
Tabaka 4: TCP na UDP, ports. Tabaka 5–7: sessions, miundo ya data na programu (HTTP, DNS, barua pepe).
Msaada wa kukumbuka kutoka juu: All People Seem To Need Data Processing.
Modeli rahisi ya TCP/IP huzipanga katika tabaka nne: Link, Internet, Transport, Application.

title.en: What is the difference between a router, a switch and an access point?
title.fr: Quelle différence entre routeur, commutateur et point d'accès ?
title.rw: Itandukaniro rya router, switch na access point ni irihe?
title.sw: Tofauti ya router, switch na access point ni ipi?

answer.en: A switch connects devices inside one network (LAN) and forwards data using MAC addresses. A router connects different networks, such as your home network and the internet, and forwards data using IP addresses. An access point adds Wi-Fi to a wired network.
answer.fr: Un commutateur (switch) relie des appareils dans un même réseau (LAN) et transmet les données avec les adresses MAC. Un routeur relie des réseaux différents, comme votre réseau domestique et Internet, et transmet avec les adresses IP. Un point d'accès ajoute le Wi-Fi à un réseau filaire.
answer.rw: Switch ihuza ibikoresho biri muri network imwe (LAN) igatanga amakuru ikoresheje aderesi za MAC. Router ihuza network zitandukanye, nk'iy'iwawe na murandasi, igatanga amakuru ikoresheje aderesi za IP. Access point yongera Wi-Fi kuri network y'insinga.
answer.sw: Switch huunganisha vifaa ndani ya mtandao mmoja (LAN) na kusambaza data kwa anwani za MAC. Router huunganisha mitandao tofauti, kama wa nyumbani na intaneti, na kusambaza data kwa anwani za IP. Access point huongeza Wi-Fi kwenye mtandao wa waya.

en: A home 'router' is often three devices in one: router, switch and Wi-Fi access point.
A modem connects you to the internet provider's line; the router shares that connection.
A hub is an old device that repeats data to every port; switches replaced it.
LAN = local network; WAN = wide area network such as the internet.
fr: Le « routeur » domestique réunit souvent trois appareils : routeur, switch et point d'accès Wi-Fi.
Un modem relie à la ligne du fournisseur ; le routeur partage cette connexion.
Un hub est un ancien appareil qui répète les données sur tous les ports ; les switchs l'ont remplacé.
LAN = réseau local ; WAN = réseau étendu comme Internet.
rw: «Router» yo mu rugo akenshi ni ibikoresho bitatu mu kimwe: router, switch na Wi-Fi access point.
Modem ihuza n'umurongo w'utanga murandasi; router isangiza uwo muhuza.
Hub ni igikoresho cya kera gisubiramo amakuru ku miryango yose; switch zayisimbuye.
LAN = network y'ahantu hamwe; WAN = network nini nka murandasi.
sw: 'Router' ya nyumbani mara nyingi ni vifaa vitatu kwa kimoja: router, switch na Wi-Fi access point.
Modem huunganisha na laini ya mtoa huduma; router hushiriki muunganisho huo.
Hub ni kifaa cha zamani kinachorudia data kwenye bandari zote; switch zilichukua nafasi yake.
LAN = mtandao wa eneo; WAN = mtandao mpana kama intaneti.

title.en: What is the difference between HTTP and HTTPS?
title.fr: Quelle différence entre HTTP et HTTPS ?
title.rw: Itandukaniro rya HTTP na HTTPS ni irihe?
title.sw: Tofauti ya HTTP na HTTPS ni ipi?

answer.en: HTTP is the protocol browsers use to fetch web pages. HTTPS is HTTP carried inside TLS encryption, so others on the network cannot read or alter what you send. HTTPS protects the connection, but it does not prove that a site is honest.
answer.fr: HTTP est le protocole que les navigateurs utilisent pour charger les pages web. HTTPS est du HTTP transporté dans un chiffrement TLS, de sorte que les autres sur le réseau ne peuvent ni lire ni modifier ce que vous envoyez. HTTPS protège la connexion mais ne prouve pas qu'un site est honnête.
answer.rw: HTTP ni protocole browser zikoresha mu gufata impapuro z'urubuga. HTTPS ni HTTP iri mu ibanga rya TLS, bityo abandi bari kuri network batabasha gusoma cyangwa guhindura ibyo wohereje. HTTPS irinda uguhuza ariko ntikerekana ko urubuga ari urwizewe.
answer.sw: HTTP ni itifaki ambayo vivinjari hutumia kupata kurasa za wavuti. HTTPS ni HTTP iliyobebwa ndani ya usimbaji fiche wa TLS, hivyo wengine kwenye mtandao hawawezi kusoma au kubadilisha unachotuma. HTTPS hulinda muunganisho lakini haithibitishi kuwa tovuti ni ya uaminifu.

en: Status codes: 200 OK, 301 moved, 403 forbidden, 404 not found, 500 server error.
Methods: GET reads data, POST sends data, PUT updates, DELETE removes.
Enter passwords and payment details only on pages that use HTTPS and whose address you checked.
fr: Codes de statut : 200 OK, 301 déplacé, 403 interdit, 404 introuvable, 500 erreur serveur.
Méthodes : GET lit, POST envoie, PUT met à jour, DELETE supprime.
Saisissez mots de passe et paiements seulement sur des pages HTTPS dont vous avez vérifié l'adresse.
rw: Kode z'imiterere: 200 OK, 301 yimuwe, 403 ibujijwe, 404 ntibonetse, 500 ikosa rya seriveri.
Uburyo: GET asoma, POST yohereza, PUT ivugurura, DELETE ikuraho.
Andika amagambo y'ibanga n'ayo kwishyura gusa ku mapaji ya HTTPS wagenzuye aderesi yayo.
sw: Misimbo ya hali: 200 OK, 301 imehamishwa, 403 imekatazwa, 404 haipatikani, 500 hitilafu ya seva.
Mbinu: GET husoma, POST hutuma, PUT husasisha, DELETE huondoa.
Weka nenosiri na malipo kwenye kurasa za HTTPS ulizohakiki anwani yake tu.

title.en: My Wi-Fi is connected but there is no internet. What can I do?
title.fr: Mon Wi-Fi est connecté mais sans internet. Que faire ?
title.rw: Wi-Fi yanjye irahujwe ariko nta murandasi. Nkore iki?
title.sw: Wi-Fi imeunganishwa lakini hakuna intaneti. Nifanye nini?

en: wifi is connected but no internet
fr: impossible de se connecter au wifi

answer.en: Work from simple to complex: check whether other devices have the same problem, restart the router, then check your own device. If every device is affected, the problem is the router or your internet provider.
answer.fr: Allez du simple au complexe : vérifiez si les autres appareils ont le même problème, redémarrez le routeur, puis vérifiez votre appareil. Si tous les appareils sont touchés, le problème vient du routeur ou du fournisseur d'accès.
answer.rw: Tangira ku byoroshye ujye ku bikomeye: reba niba ibindi bikoresho bifite ikibazo kimwe, ukore restart ya router, hanyuma urebe igikoresho cyawe. Niba bifite byose, ikibazo kiri kuri router cyangwa ku utanga murandasi.
answer.sw: Fanya kutoka rahisi hadi ngumu: angalia kama vifaa vingine vina tatizo hilo, washa router upya, kisha angalia kifaa chako. Ikiwa vifaa vyote vimeathirika, tatizo ni router au mtoa huduma wa intaneti.

en: Unplug the router for 30 seconds, plug it back in, and wait a couple of minutes.
On your device: turn Wi-Fi off and on, or 'forget' the network and reconnect.
Check that your data bundle or subscription is still active.
Move closer to the router; if names fail but `ping 8.8.8.8` works, see DNS. Still stuck? Call your provider.
fr: Débranchez le routeur 30 secondes, rebranchez-le et attendez quelques minutes.
Sur votre appareil : coupez et rallumez le Wi-Fi, ou « oubliez » le réseau et reconnectez-vous.
Vérifiez que votre forfait ou abonnement est toujours actif.
Rapprochez-vous du routeur ; si les noms échouent mais `ping 8.8.8.8` marche, voyez le DNS. Toujours bloqué ? Appelez votre fournisseur.
rw: Kuramo router mu muriro amasegonda 30, uyisubizemo ugategereze iminota mike.
Ku gikoresho cyawe: zimya ukongere Wi-Fi, cyangwa «wibagirwe» network wongere uyihuze.
Reba ko ifatabuguzi cyangwa ama bundle ya murandasi bikiriho.
Sanga router hafi; niba amazina ananirwa ariko `ping 8.8.8.8` ikora, reba DNS. Biracyananiranye? Hamagara utanga murandasi.
sw: Chomoa router kwa sekunde 30, iunganishe tena na usubiri dakika chache.
Kwenye kifaa chako: zima na uwashe Wi-Fi, au 'sahau' mtandao na uunganishe tena.
Hakikisha kifurushi chako cha data au usajili bado unafanya kazi.
Sogea karibu na router; majina yakishindwa lakini `ping 8.8.8.8` ikifanya kazi, angalia DNS. Bado umekwama? Piga simu mtoa huduma.

title.en: How do the English tenses work (present, past, future)?
title.fr: Comment fonctionnent les temps de l'anglais (présent, passé, futur) ?
title.rw: Ibihe by'icyongereza (ubu, ahahise, ejo hazaza) bikora bite?
title.sw: Nyakati za Kiingereza (sasa, uliopita, ujao) hufanyaje kazi?

answer.en: English uses a verb form for each time. Present simple is for habits and facts, present continuous for actions happening now, past simple for finished actions, present perfect for past actions that matter now, and `will` or `going to` for the future.
answer.fr: L'anglais utilise une forme verbale par moment. Le present simple sert aux habitudes et aux faits, le present continuous aux actions en cours, le past simple aux actions terminées, le present perfect aux actions passées qui comptent maintenant, et `will` ou `going to` au futur.
answer.rw: Icyongereza gikoresha imiterere y'ikinyazina kuri buri gihe. Present simple ni iy'ingeso n'ukuri, present continuous ni iy'ibikorwa bibera ubu, past simple ni iy'ibyarangiye, present perfect ni iy'ibyabaye bifite akamaro ubu, naho `will` cyangwa `going to` ni ibihe bizaza.
answer.sw: Kiingereza hutumia umbo la kitenzi kwa kila wakati. Present simple ni kwa mazoea na ukweli, present continuous kwa vitendo vinavyoendelea sasa, past simple kwa vilivyokwisha, present perfect kwa vya zamani vyenye maana sasa, na `will` au `going to` kwa wakati ujao.

en: Present simple: `She works every day.`  Present continuous: `She is working now.`
Past simple: `She worked yesterday.`  Present perfect: `She has worked here for two years.`
Future: `She will work tomorrow.` or `She is going to work tomorrow.`
Questions and negatives use `do/does/did`: `Does she work?` `She did not work.`
fr: Present simple : `She works every day.`  Present continuous : `She is working now.`
Past simple : `She worked yesterday.`  Present perfect : `She has worked here for two years.`
Futur : `She will work tomorrow.` ou `She is going to work tomorrow.`
Questions et négations avec `do/does/did` : `Does she work?` `She did not work.`
rw: Present simple: `She works every day.`  Present continuous: `She is working now.`
Past simple: `She worked yesterday.`  Present perfect: `She has worked here for two years.`
Ejo hazaza: `She will work tomorrow.` cyangwa `She is going to work tomorrow.`
Ibibazo n'ibihakana bikoresha `do/does/did`: `Does she work?` `She did not work.`
sw: Present simple: `She works every day.`  Present continuous: `She is working now.`
Past simple: `She worked yesterday.`  Present perfect: `She has worked here for two years.`
Wakati ujao: `She will work tomorrow.` au `She is going to work tomorrow.`
Maswali na kukanusha hutumia `do/does/did`: `Does she work?` `She did not work.`

title.en: When do I use a, an and the in English?
title.fr: Quand utiliser a, an et the en anglais ?
title.rw: Ni ryari nkoresha a, an na the mu cyongereza?
title.sw: Nitumie lini a, an na the katika Kiingereza?

en: when to use a or an
rw: igihe cyo gukoresha a cyangwa an

answer.en: Use `a` or `an` for one non-specific thing, and `the` for something specific that both people know about. Use `an` before a vowel sound, `a` before a consonant sound. The confusing trio: `their` (belonging to them), `there` (a place), `they're` (they are).
answer.fr: Utilisez `a` ou `an` pour une chose non précise et `the` pour une chose précise connue des deux. `an` devant un son voyelle, `a` devant un son consonne. Le trio qui prête à confusion : `their` (leur), `there` (là), `they're` (ils sont).
answer.rw: Koresha `a` cyangwa `an` ku kintu kimwe kitazwi neza, na `the` ku kintu kizwi n'impande zombi. `an` imbere y'ijwi ry'inyajwi, `a` imbere y'ijwi ry'ingombajwi. Aya atatu ashobora kuvanga: `their` (yabo), `there` (aho), `they're` (bo ni).
answer.sw: Tumia `a` au `an` kwa kitu kimoja kisichotajwa mahususi, na `the` kwa kitu mahususi kinachojulikana na wote. `an` kabla ya sauti ya irabu, `a` kabla ya sauti ya konsonanti. Watatu wanaochanganya: `their` (yao), `there` (huko), `they're` (wao ni).

en: `a book`, `an apple`, `an hour` (silent h), `a university` (sounds like 'you').
`I saw a dog. The dog was big.` — first mention `a`, then `the`.
No article for general plurals: `Dogs are loyal.`
fr: `a book`, `an apple`, `an hour` (h muet), `a university` (se prononce « you »).
`I saw a dog. The dog was big.` — première mention `a`, ensuite `the`.
Pas d'article pour les pluriels généraux : `Dogs are loyal.`
rw: `a book`, `an apple`, `an hour` (h ntivugwa), `a university` (ivugwa nka «you»).
`I saw a dog. The dog was big.` — ubwa mbere `a`, hanyuma `the`.
Nta article ku mubare w'ibintu byinshi muri rusange: `Dogs are loyal.`
sw: `I saw a dog. The dog was big.` — mara ya kwanza `a`, kisha `the`.
Hakuna article kwa wingi wa jumla: `Dogs are loyal.`

title.en: How can I improve my English quickly?
title.fr: Comment améliorer mon anglais rapidement ?
title.rw: Nakwiga nte icyongereza vuba?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kuboresha Kiingereza changu haraka?

answer.en: Daily contact beats long weekly study. Listen, speak, read and write a little every day, learn words in sentences instead of lists, and accept mistakes as part of learning.
answer.fr: Un contact quotidien vaut mieux qu'une longue étude hebdomadaire. Écoutez, parlez, lisez et écrivez un peu chaque jour, apprenez les mots dans des phrases plutôt que des listes, et acceptez les erreurs comme faisant partie de l'apprentissage.
answer.rw: Gukora buri munsi biruta kwiga igihe kirekire rimwe mu cyumweru. Umva, vuga, soma kandi wandike gato buri munsi, wige amagambo mu nteruro aho kuyiga nk'urutonde, kandi wemere amakosa nk'igice cyo kwiga.
answer.sw: Mazoezi ya kila siku yanashinda kusoma kwingi mara moja kwa wiki. Sikiliza, ongea, soma na andika kidogo kila siku, jifunze maneno ndani ya sentensi badala ya orodha, na ukubali makosa kama sehemu ya kujifunza.

en: Listen: 15 minutes daily of radio, podcasts or videos with subtitles.
Speak: talk aloud to yourself or a friend; record yourself and listen back.
Read: short news or stories at your level; note 5 new words and write a sentence with each.
Write: keep a 3-sentence daily journal and ask someone to correct it.
fr: Écoutez : 15 minutes par jour de radio, podcasts ou vidéos sous-titrées.
Parlez : à voix haute, seul ou avec un ami ; enregistrez-vous et réécoutez.
Lisez : articles ou histoires courts à votre niveau ; notez 5 mots nouveaux et faites une phrase avec chacun.
Écrivez : un journal de 3 phrases par jour et faites-le corriger.
rw: Umva: iminota 15 buri munsi kuri radiyo, podcasts cyangwa amashusho afite subtitles.
Vuga: wivugishe cyangwa uvugane n'inshuti; wifate amajwi uyumve.
Soma: inkuru ngufi zijyanye n'urwego rwawe; andika amagambo 5 mashya ukore interuro kuri buri rimwe.
Andika: ikayi y'interuro 3 buri munsi ugire uwo uyisomera akosore.
sw: Sikiliza: dakika 15 kila siku redio, podcast au video zenye manukuu.
Ongea: jisemee kwa sauti au na rafiki; jirekodi na usikilize.
Soma: habari au hadithi fupi za kiwango chako; andika maneno mapya 5 na utunge sentensi kwa kila moja.
Andika: shajara ya sentensi 3 kila siku na umwombe mtu akusahihishie.

title.en: How can I sleep better?
title.fr: Comment mieux dormir ?
title.rw: Nakora iki ngo ndyame neza?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kulala vizuri zaidi?

answer.en: Most adults do best with about 7–9 hours. A steady routine matters more than any trick: same bedtime and wake time, a dark and quiet room, and less screen and caffeine late in the day. If poor sleep lasts for weeks, speak to a health worker.
answer.fr: La plupart des adultes se portent mieux avec environ 7 à 9 heures. Une routine régulière compte plus que n'importe quelle astuce : mêmes heures de coucher et de lever, chambre sombre et calme, moins d'écrans et de caféine en fin de journée. Si le mauvais sommeil dure des semaines, consultez un professionnel de santé.
answer.rw: Abantu benshi bakuru bakeneye amasaha nka 7–9. Gahunda ihoraho irusha ubundi buryo bwose: kuryama no gukanguka ku masaha amwe, icyumba cyijimye kandi gituje, no kugabanya telefoni na kawa nijoro. Niba kubura ibitotsi bimaze ibyumweru, vugana n'umuganga.
answer.sw: Watu wazima wengi hufanya vizuri na masaa 7–9. Ratiba thabiti ni muhimu kuliko mbinu yoyote: muda uleule wa kulala na kuamka, chumba chenye giza na utulivu, na skrini na kafeini kidogo jioni. Usingizi mbaya ukidumu wiki, zungumza na mhudumu wa afya.

en: Keep the same sleep and wake times, even on weekends.
Stop screens and heavy meals 1 hour before bed; avoid coffee, tea and energy drinks in the afternoon.
Keep the room dark, cool and quiet; use the bed only for sleep.
If you cannot sleep after about 20 minutes, get up, do something calm, and return when sleepy.
fr: Gardez les mêmes heures de coucher et de réveil, même le week-end.
Pas d'écran ni de repas lourd 1 heure avant le coucher ; évitez café, thé et boissons énergisantes l'après-midi.
Chambre sombre, fraîche et calme ; le lit sert uniquement à dormir.
Si vous ne dormez pas après environ 20 minutes, levez-vous, faites une activité calme et revenez quand vous avez sommeil.
rw: Komeza amasaha amwe yo kuryama no gukanguka, ndetse no ku mpera z'icyumweru.
Reka telefoni n'amafunguro aremereye isaha 1 mbere yo kuryama; irinde kawa, icyayi n'ibinyobwa bitera imbaraga nyuma ya saa sita.
Icyumba kijimye, gikonje kandi gituje; uburiri ukoreshe gusa mu gusinzira.
Niba utasinziriye nyuma y'iminota nka 20, haguruka ukore ikintu gituje, usubire uryamye ubonye ibitotsi.
sw: Dumisha muda uleule wa kulala na kuamka, hata wikendi.
Acha skrini na mlo mzito saa 1 kabla ya kulala; epuka kahawa, chai na vinywaji vya kuongeza nguvu mchana.
Chumba kiwe giza, baridi na kimya; tumia kitanda kwa kulala tu.
Usipopata usingizi baada ya dakika 20 hivi, inuka, fanya jambo tulivu, urudi ukiwa na usingizi.

title.en: How can I manage stress and stay calm?
title.fr: Comment gérer le stress et rester calme ?
title.rw: Nakurikirana nte stress nkagumana ituze?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kudhibiti msongo wa mawazo na kutulia?

answer.en: Stress is a normal reaction, and small daily habits reduce it. Slow breathing calms the body within minutes, a short walk and enough sleep help, and breaking a big problem into small steps makes it feel manageable. Talking to someone you trust helps too.
answer.fr: Le stress est une réaction normale, et de petites habitudes quotidiennes le réduisent. Une respiration lente calme le corps en quelques minutes, une courte marche et assez de sommeil aident, et découper un gros problème en petites étapes le rend gérable. En parler à quelqu'un de confiance aide aussi.
answer.rw: Stress ni ikintu gisanzwe, kandi imigirire mito ya buri munsi iyigabanya. Guhumeka buhoro bituza umubiri mu minota mike, gutembera gato no gusinzira bihagije biragufasha, no gucamo ikibazo kinini intambwe ntoya bituma cyoroha. Kuganira n'uwo wizeye na byo bifasha.
answer.sw: Msongo ni mwitikio wa kawaida, na mazoea madogo ya kila siku huupunguza. Kupumua polepole hutuliza mwili ndani ya dakika, matembezi mafupi na usingizi wa kutosha husaidia, na kugawa tatizo kubwa kwa hatua ndogo hulifanya liwe rahisi. Kuzungumza na mtu unayemwamini pia husaidia.

en: Breathe: in for 4 seconds, out for 6, repeat for 2 minutes.
Move: a 10-minute walk or light stretching.
Write down what worries you, then pick one small action you can do today.
If you feel hopeless, cannot function for weeks, or think of harming yourself, contact a health worker or someone you trust right away.
fr: Respirez : inspirez 4 secondes, expirez 6, répétez 2 minutes.
Bougez : 10 minutes de marche ou d'étirements doux.
Notez ce qui vous inquiète, puis choisissez une petite action possible aujourd'hui.
Si vous vous sentez sans espoir, incapable de fonctionner depuis des semaines, ou pensez à vous faire du mal, contactez immédiatement un professionnel de santé ou une personne de confiance.
rw: Humeka: injiza amasegonda 4, sohora 6, subiramo iminota 2.
Igenda: gutembera iminota 10 cyangwa kwinanura byoroheje.
Andika ibigutera impungenge, hanyuma uhitemo igikorwa gito wakora uyu munsi.
Niba wumva nta byiringiro, utabasha gukora ibyo wakoraga mu byumweru, cyangwa utekereza kwigirira nabi, hamagara umuganga cyangwa umuntu wizeye ako kanya.
sw: Pumua: vuta pumzi sekunde 4, toa 6, rudia dakika 2.
Sogea: tembea dakika 10 au fanya kunyoosha mwili kwepesi.
Andika kinachokuhangaisha, kisha chagua hatua ndogo moja unayoweza kufanya leo.
Ukihisi huna matumaini, huwezi kufanya kazi kwa wiki, au unafikiria kujidhuru, wasiliana na mhudumu wa afya au mtu unayemwamini mara moja.

title.en: What is the best way to learn a new language?
title.fr: Quelle est la meilleure façon d'apprendre une nouvelle langue ?
title.rw: Uburyo bwiza bwo kwiga ururimi rushya ni ubuhe?
title.sw: Njia bora ya kujifunza lugha mpya ni ipi?

en: best way to learn a language

answer.en: Use the language daily in small amounts. Start with the 500–1000 most common words, learn them in phrases, speak from the first week even if imperfectly, and find a partner or community to practise with.
answer.fr: Utilisez la langue chaque jour, par petites doses. Commencez par les 500 à 1000 mots les plus courants, apprenez-les en phrases, parlez dès la première semaine même imparfaitement, et trouvez un partenaire ou une communauté pour pratiquer.
answer.rw: Koresha ururimi buri munsi mu bice bito. Tangira n'amagambo 500–1000 akunze gukoreshwa, uyige mu nteruro, tangira kuvuga kuva mu cyumweru cya mbere nubwo utaba wuzuye, ushake umuntu cyangwa itsinda mukorana imyitozo.
answer.sw: Tumia lugha kila siku kwa kiasi kidogo. Anza na maneno 500–1000 yanayotumika zaidi, yajifunze ndani ya vishazi, anza kuongea tangu wiki ya kwanza hata bila ukamilifu, na utafute mwenzi au jamii ya kufanya mazoezi.

en: Learn phrases, not single words: `Where is the market?` rather than just `market`.
Spend 20 minutes a day; consistency beats long rare sessions.
Use spaced repetition (flashcards that bring back words just before you forget them).
Label things around you, listen to local radio, and speak with a native speaker weekly.
fr: Apprenez des phrases, pas des mots isolés : `Où est le marché ?` plutôt que `marché`.
20 minutes par jour ; la régularité bat les longues séances rares.
Utilisez la répétition espacée (cartes mémoire qui ramènent un mot juste avant l'oubli).
Étiquetez les objets autour de vous, écoutez la radio locale et parlez chaque semaine avec un locuteur natif.
rw: Wige interuro, si amagambo yonyine: `Isoko riri he?` aho kwiga `isoko` gusa.
Fata iminota 20 ku munsi; gukora buri munsi biruta amasomo maremare adakunze.
Koresha spaced repetition (amakarita agusubiriza ijambo mbere yo kurizibagirwa).
Andika amazina ku bintu bikuzengurutse, wumve radiyo yaho, kandi uvugane n'uvuka muri urwo rurimi buri cyumweru.
sw: Jifunze vishazi, si maneno peke yake: `Soko liko wapi?` badala ya `soko` tu.
Tumia dakika 20 kwa siku; uthabiti hushinda vipindi virefu adimu.
Tumia spaced repetition (kadi zinazokurudishia neno kabla hujalisahau).
Weka lebo kwa vitu vinavyokuzunguka, sikiliza redio ya eneo, na uongee na mzungumzaji asilia kila wiki.

title.en: How can I stay motivated and build good habits?
title.fr: Comment rester motivé et acquérir de bonnes habitudes ?
title.rw: Nakomeza nte gushishikara no kugira ingeso nziza?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kubaki na motisha na kujenga tabia nzuri?

answer.en: Motivation follows action more often than it comes before it. Set a clear small goal, make the first step so easy you cannot refuse it, tie the habit to something you already do daily, and track your progress where you can see it.
answer.fr: La motivation suit souvent l'action plus qu'elle ne la précède. Fixez un petit objectif clair, rendez la première étape si facile qu'on ne peut la refuser, liez l'habitude à quelque chose que vous faites déjà chaque jour et suivez vos progrès à un endroit visible.
answer.rw: Ishyaka akenshi rikurikira igikorwa aho kukibanziriza. Shyiraho intego nto kandi isobanutse, intambwe ya mbere uyigire yoroshye cyane, uhuze ingeso n'ikintu usanzwe ukora buri munsi, kandi ukurikirane iterambere ahabonwa.
answer.sw: Motisha mara nyingi hufuata kitendo kuliko kukitangulia. Weka lengo dogo lililo wazi, fanya hatua ya kwanza iwe rahisi sana, unganisha tabia na kitu unachofanya kila siku, na ufuatilie maendeleo mahali panapoonekana.

en: Goal: 'Write 5 sentences daily' is better than 'become a writer'.
Start with 2 minutes: put on your running shoes, open the book, write one line.
Attach it: after morning tea, I study for 20 minutes.
Mark an X on a calendar each day you do it; try not to miss two days in a row.
fr: Objectif : « écrire 5 phrases par jour » vaut mieux que « devenir écrivain ».
Commencez par 2 minutes : mettre ses chaussures, ouvrir le livre, écrire une ligne.
Associez-la : après le thé du matin, j'étudie 20 minutes.
Cochez un X par jour réalisé sur un calendrier ; évitez de manquer deux jours de suite.
rw: Intego: «kwandika interuro 5 buri munsi» iruta «kuba umwanditsi».
Tangira n'iminota 2: wambare inkweto, fungura igitabo, wandike umurongo umwe.
Yihuze n'ikindi: nyuma y'icyayi cya mu gitondo, nsoma iminota 20.
Shyira X ku kalendari buri munsi ukoze; gerageza kudasiba iminsi ibiri ikurikirana.
sw: Lengo: 'andika sentensi 5 kila siku' ni bora kuliko 'kuwa mwandishi'.
Anza na dakika 2: vaa viatu, fungua kitabu, andika mstari mmoja.
Iambatanishe: baada ya chai ya asubuhi, nasoma dakika 20.
Weka alama ya X kwenye kalenda kila siku unapofanya; jaribu kutokosa siku mbili mfululizo.

title.en: How do I find the area and circumference of a circle?
title.fr: Comment calculer l'aire et la circonférence d'un cercle ?
title.rw: Nabara nte ubuso n'umuzenguruko w'uruziga?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kupata eneo na mzingo wa duara?

answer.en: For a circle with radius r: area = πr², circumference = 2πr = πd (d is the diameter, twice the radius). Use π ≈ 3.14159.
answer.fr: Pour un cercle de rayon r : aire = πr², circonférence = 2πr = πd (d est le diamètre, le double du rayon). Utilisez π ≈ 3,14159.
answer.rw: Ku ruziga rufite radius r: ubuso = πr², umuzenguruko = 2πr = πd (d ni diameter, kabiri ka radius). Koresha π ≈ 3.14159.
answer.sw: Kwa duara lenye radius r: eneo = πr², mzingo = 2πr = πd (d ni kipenyo, mara mbili ya radius). Tumia π ≈ 3.14159.

en: If you are given the diameter, halve it first: r = d ÷ 2.
fr: Si on donne le diamètre, divisez-le d'abord par 2 : r = d ÷ 2.
Volume du cylindre = πr²h ; volume de la sphère = (4/3)πr³.
rw: Niba hatanzwe diameter, banza uyigabanyemo kabiri: r = d ÷ 2.
Ingano ya cylinder = πr²h; ingano ya sphere = (4/3)πr³.
sw: Ukipewa kipenyo, kigawanye kwa 2 kwanza: r = d ÷ 2.
Ujazo wa silinda = πr²h; ujazo wa tufe = (4/3)πr³.

title.en: How do I solve ratio and proportion problems?
title.fr: Comment résoudre les problèmes de ratio et de proportion ?
title.rw: Nakemura nte ibibazo bya ratio na proportion?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kutatua maswali ya uwiano na ulinganifu?

answer.en: A ratio compares quantities (3:2). In direct proportion, if one quantity doubles the other doubles; solve it by finding the value of one unit (unitary method) or by cross-multiplying. To share an amount in a ratio, add the parts first.
answer.fr: Un ratio compare des quantités (3:2). En proportion directe, si l'une double, l'autre double ; résolvez en trouvant la valeur d'une unité (méthode unitaire) ou par produit en croix. Pour partager selon un rapport, additionnez d'abord les parts.
answer.rw: Ratio igereranya ingano (3:2). Muri proportion itaziguye, iyo imwe iba kabiri indi na yo iba kabiri; ukemura ushaka agaciro k'ikimwe (unitary method) cyangwa ukoresheje cross-multiplication. Gusaranganya muri ratio banza ujyanye ibice.
answer.sw: Uwiano hulinganisha kiasi (3:2). Katika ulinganifu wa moja kwa moja, kimoja kikiongezeka mara mbili kingine pia; tatua kwa kupata thamani ya kimoja (njia ya unitary) au kuzidisha kwa mkato. Kugawanya kwa uwiano, jumlisha sehemu kwanza.

en: Unitary: 5 kg of beans cost 4000 RWF → 1 kg costs 4000 ÷ 5 = 800 → 8 kg cost 8 × 800 = 6400 RWF.
Share 120 in the ratio 3:2: parts = 3 + 2 = 5; one part = 120 ÷ 5 = 24; shares 72 and 48.
Inverse proportion: 4 workers take 6 days → 6 workers take 4 × 6 ÷ 6 = 4 days.
fr: Unitaire : 5 kg de haricots coûtent 4000 RWF → 1 kg coûte 4000 ÷ 5 = 800 → 8 kg coûtent 8 × 800 = 6400 RWF.
Partager 120 selon 3:2 : parts = 3 + 2 = 5 ; une part = 120 ÷ 5 = 24 ; parts 72 et 48.
Proportion inverse : 4 ouvriers mettent 6 jours → 6 ouvriers mettent 4 × 6 ÷ 6 = 4 jours.
rw: Unitary: ibiro 5 by'ibishyimbo bigura 4000 RWF → ikiro 1 kigura 4000 ÷ 5 = 800 → ibiro 8 bigura 8 × 800 = 6400 RWF.
Gusaranganya 120 muri 3:2: ibice = 3 + 2 = 5; igice kimwe = 120 ÷ 5 = 24; ibice ni 72 na 48.
Proportion ihinduranye: abakozi 4 bakora iminsi 6 → abakozi 6 bakora 4 × 6 ÷ 6 = iminsi 4.
sw: Unitary: kilo 5 za maharage zinagharimu 4000 RWF → kilo 1 ni 4000 ÷ 5 = 800 → kilo 8 ni 8 × 800 = 6400 RWF.
Gawanya 120 kwa 3:2: sehemu = 3 + 2 = 5; sehemu moja = 120 ÷ 5 = 24; mgao 72 na 48.
Ulinganifu kinyume: wafanyakazi 4 huchukua siku 6 → wafanyakazi 6 huchukua 4 × 6 ÷ 6 = siku 4.

title.en: What are sine, cosine and tangent (SOH CAH TOA)?
title.fr: Que sont sinus, cosinus et tangente (SOH CAH TOA) ?
title.rw: Sine, cosine na tangent ni iki (SOH CAH TOA)?
title.sw: Sine, cosine na tangent ni nini (SOH CAH TOA)?

rw: trigonometry y'inyabutatu ifite inguni ya dogere
sw: trigonometria ya pembetatu yenye pembe ya kulia

answer.en: In a right-angled triangle, with θ one of the other angles: sin θ = opposite ÷ hypotenuse, cos θ = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse, tan θ = opposite ÷ adjacent. Remember it as SOH-CAH-TOA.
answer.fr: Dans un triangle rectangle, θ étant un des autres angles : sin θ = opposé ÷ hypoténuse, cos θ = adjacent ÷ hypoténuse, tan θ = opposé ÷ adjacent. Retenez SOH-CAH-TOA.
answer.rw: Mu nyabutatu ifite inguni ya dogere, θ ari imwe mu zindi nguni: sin θ = opposite ÷ hypotenuse, cos θ = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse, tan θ = opposite ÷ adjacent. Wibuke SOH-CAH-TOA.
answer.sw: Katika pembetatu yenye pembe ya kulia, θ ikiwa mojawapo ya pembe nyingine: sin θ = opposite ÷ hypotenuse, cos θ = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse, tan θ = opposite ÷ adjacent. Kumbuka SOH-CAH-TOA.

en: Example: opposite = 3, hypotenuse = 6 → sin θ = 0.5 → θ = 30° (use sin⁻¹ on a calculator).
Find a side: hypotenuse 10, θ = 30° → opposite = 10 × sin 30° = 5.
Make sure the calculator is in degree mode, not radians.
fr: Exemple : opposé = 3, hypoténuse = 6 → sin θ = 0,5 → θ = 30° (utilisez sin⁻¹ sur la calculatrice).
Trouver un côté : hypoténuse 10, θ = 30° → opposé = 10 × sin 30° = 5.
Vérifiez que la calculatrice est en degrés, pas en radians.
rw: Urugero: opposite = 3, hypotenuse = 6 → sin θ = 0.5 → θ = 30° (koresha sin⁻¹ kuri calculator).
Kubona uruhande: hypotenuse 10, θ = 30° → opposite = 10 × sin 30° = 5.
Menya neza ko calculator iri muri degrees, ntabwo ari radians.
sw: Mfano: opposite = 3, hypotenuse = 6 → sin θ = 0.5 → θ = 30° (tumia sin⁻¹ kwenye kikokotoo).
Kupata upande: hypotenuse 10, θ = 30° → opposite = 10 × sin 30° = 5.
Hakikisha kikokotoo kiko kwenye degrees, si radians.

title.en: How do I differentiate a function (derivative rules)?
title.fr: Comment dériver une fonction (règles de dérivation) ?
title.rw: Nakora nte derivative y'imikorere (amategeko ya derivative)?
title.sw: Ninawezaje kupata derivative ya kitendakazi (kanuni za derivative)?

answer.en: The derivative gives the rate of change (the slope) of a function. Power rule: the derivative of xⁿ is n·xⁿ⁻¹. Constants become 0, and you differentiate sums term by term.
answer.fr: La dérivée donne le taux de variation (la pente) d'une fonction. Règle de puissance : la dérivée de xⁿ est n·xⁿ⁻¹. Les constantes deviennent 0 et on dérive les sommes terme à terme.
answer.rw: Derivative itanga umuvuduko w'ihinduka (slope) w'imikorere. Power rule: derivative ya xⁿ ni n·xⁿ⁻¹. Ibihoraho biba 0, kandi ujya ukora derivative y'ibice by'igiteranyo kimwe kimwe.
answer.sw: Derivative hutoa kiwango cha mabadiliko (mteremko) wa kitendakazi. Power rule: derivative ya xⁿ ni n·xⁿ⁻¹. Vigezo hubadilika kuwa 0, na unatafuta derivative ya jumla neno kwa neno.

en: Product rule: (u·v)′ = u′v + uv′. Example: (x·sin x)′ = sin x + x·cos x.
Chain rule: for f(g(x)), the derivative is f′(g(x))·g′(x). Example: (x²+1)³ → 3(x²+1)²·2x.
Maximum or minimum: solve f′(x) = 0, then check the sign change.
fr: Règle du produit : (u·v)′ = u′v + uv′. Exemple : (x·sin x)′ = sin x + x·cos x.
Règle de la chaîne : pour f(g(x)), la dérivée est f′(g(x))·g′(x). Exemple : (x²+1)³ → 3(x²+1)²·2x.
Maximum ou minimum : résolvez f′(x) = 0, puis vérifiez le changement de signe.
rw: Product rule: (u·v)′ = u′v + uv′. Urugero: (x·sin x)′ = sin x + x·cos x.
Chain rule: kuri f(g(x)), derivative ni f′(g(x))·g′(x). Urugero: (x²+1)³ → 3(x²+1)²·2x.
Maximum cyangwa minimum: kemura f′(x) = 0, hanyuma urebe uko ikimenyetso gihinduka.
sw: Product rule: (u·v)′ = u′v + uv′. Mfano: (x·sin x)′ = sin x + x·cos x.
Chain rule: kwa f(g(x)), derivative ni f′(g(x))·g′(x). Mfano: (x²+1)³ → 3(x²+1)²·2x.
Kilele au kina: tatua f′(x) = 0, kisha angalia mabadiliko ya alama.

title.en: What is gravity and how do objects fall?
title.fr: Qu'est-ce que la gravité et comment tombent les objets ?
title.rw: Gravity ni iki kandi ibintu bigwa bite?
title.sw: Mvutano wa dunia ni nini na vitu huanguka vipi?

answer.en: Near Earth's surface gravity gives every falling object the same acceleration g ≈ 9.8 m/s² (ignoring air resistance), so heavy and light objects fall together. Mass (kg) is how much matter; weight (N) is the force of gravity: W = m·g.
answer.fr: Près de la surface terrestre, la gravité donne à tout objet qui tombe la même accélération g ≈ 9,8 m/s² (sans résistance de l'air), donc objets lourds et légers tombent ensemble. La masse (kg) est la quantité de matière ; le poids (N) est la force de gravité : P = m·g.
answer.rw: Hafi y'isi, gravity iha ikintu cyose kigwa umuvuduko wongerwa umwe g ≈ 9.8 m/s² (nta rwanya rw'umwuka), bityo ibiremereye n'ibyoroheje bigwa icyarimwe. Mass (kg) ni ingano y'ibintu; weight (N) ni imbaraga ya gravity: W = m·g.
answer.sw: Karibu na uso wa dunia mvutano hutoa kila kitu kinachoanguka kasi sawa g ≈ 9.8 m/s² (bila kuzingatia upinzani wa hewa), hivyo vizito na vyepesi huanguka pamoja. Wingi (kg) ni kiasi cha mada; uzito (N) ni nguvu ya mvutano: W = m·g.

en: Dropped from rest for 3 s: v = g·t = 9.8 × 3 = 29.4 m/s; distance = ½·g·t² = ½ × 9.8 × 9 = 44.1 m.
Time to fall from height h: t = √(2h ÷ g).
On the Moon g ≈ 1.6 m/s²: your mass stays the same, your weight is smaller.
fr: Lâché sans vitesse pendant 3 s : v = g·t = 9,8 × 3 = 29,4 m/s ; distance = ½·g·t² = ½ × 9,8 × 9 = 44,1 m.
Temps de chute depuis une hauteur h : t = √(2h ÷ g).
Sur la Lune g ≈ 1,6 m/s² : votre masse reste la même, votre poids est plus petit.
rw: Iyo ugwa utangiye ku butumburuke amasegonda 3: v = g·t = 9.8 × 3 = 29.4 m/s; intera = ½·g·t² = ½ × 9.8 × 9 = 44.1 m.
Igihe cyo kugwa uva ku burebure h: t = √(2h ÷ g).
Ku kwezi g ≈ 1.6 m/s²: mass yawe ntihinduka, ariko weight iba nto.
sw: Ukiachwa kutoka kituo kwa sekunde 3: v = g·t = 9.8 × 3 = 29.4 m/s; umbali = ½·g·t² = ½ × 9.8 × 9 = 44.1 m.
Muda wa kuanguka kutoka urefu h: t = √(2h ÷ g).
Mwezini g ≈ 1.6 m/s²: wingi wako haubadiliki, uzito unapungua.

title.en: How do I calculate resistors in series and in parallel?
title.fr: Comment calculer des résistances en série et en parallèle ?
title.rw: Mbara nte resistors muri series no muri parallel?
title.sw: Ninahesabuje vipingamizi katika mfululizo na sambamba vipi?

answer.en: In series the resistances add: R = R₁ + R₂ + …, and the same current flows through all. In parallel the reciprocals add: 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …, and the same voltage is across each branch. Parallel total is always smaller than the smallest resistor.
answer.fr: En série les résistances s'additionnent : R = R₁ + R₂ + …, et le même courant les traverse. En parallèle les inverses s'additionnent : 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …, et la tension est la même sur chaque branche. Le total en parallèle est toujours plus petit que la plus petite résistance.
answer.rw: Muri series resistances ziraterana: R = R₁ + R₂ + …, kandi umuriro umwe unyura muri zose. Muri parallel inverses ziraterana: 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …, kandi voltage imwe iri kuri buri shami. Igiteranyo cya parallel buri gihe kiba gito kuruta resistor ntoya.
answer.sw: Katika mfululizo vipingamizi hujumlishwa: R = R₁ + R₂ + …, na mkondo uleule hupita katika vyote. Katika sambamba viinverse hujumlishwa: 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …, na volteji ileile iko kwenye kila tawi. Jumla ya sambamba daima ni ndogo kuliko kipingamizi kidogo kuliko vyote.

en: Two in parallel (shortcut): R = (R₁ × R₂) ÷ (R₁ + R₂); 6 Ω and 3 Ω → 18 ÷ 9 = 2 Ω.
Then use Ohm's law V = I × R with the total resistance to find the current.
fr: Deux en parallèle (raccourci) : R = (R₁ × R₂) ÷ (R₁ + R₂) ; 6 Ω et 3 Ω → 18 ÷ 9 = 2 Ω.
Utilisez ensuite la loi d'Ohm V = I × R avec la résistance totale pour trouver le courant.
rw: Ebyiri muri parallel (uburyo bwihuse): R = (R₁ × R₂) ÷ (R₁ + R₂); 6 Ω na 3 Ω → 18 ÷ 9 = 2 Ω.
Hanyuma koresha itegeko rya Ohm V = I × R ukoresheje resistance yose kugira ngo ubone current.
sw: Mbili sambamba (njia fupi): R = (R₁ × R₂) ÷ (R₁ + R₂); 6 Ω na 3 Ω → 18 ÷ 9 = 2 Ω.
Kisha tumia sheria ya Ohm V = I × R kwa upinzani jumla kupata mkondo.

title.en: How do I write functions in PHP?
title.fr: Comment écrire des fonctions en PHP ?
title.rw: Nandika nte functions muri PHP?
title.sw: Ninaandikaje functions katika PHP?

answer.en: A function groups code you want to reuse. Define it with `function name($param) { ... }`, send back a result with `return`, and split big programs into files with `require`.
answer.fr: Une fonction regroupe du code réutilisable. Définissez-la avec `function name($param) { ... }`, renvoyez un résultat avec `return` et découpez les gros programmes en fichiers avec `require`.
answer.rw: Function ni igice cya code ushaka gukoresha kenshi. Ugisobanura ukoresheje `function name($param) { ... }`, ugasubiza igisubizo ukoresheje `return`, kandi ugacamo porogaramu nini amadosiye ukoresheje `require`.
answer.sw: Function hukusanya msimbo unaotaka kutumia tena. Ifafanue kwa `function name($param) { ... }`, rudisha matokeo kwa `return`, na ugawanye programu kubwa kuwa faili kwa `require`.

en: Share code: `require "config.php";` stops the script if the file is missing; `include` only warns.
fr: Partager du code : `require "config.php";` arrête le script si le fichier manque ; `include` avertit seulement.
rw: Gusangiza code: `require "config.php";` ihagarika script iyo idosiye ibuze; `include` ivuga gusa umuburo.
sw: Kushiriki msimbo: `require "config.php";` husimamisha script faili ikikosekana; `include` huonya tu.

title.en: What are classes and objects in PHP (OOP)?
title.fr: Que sont les classes et objets en PHP (POO) ?
title.rw: Classes na objects muri PHP (OOP) ni iki?
title.sw: Classes na objects katika PHP (OOP) ni nini?

answer.en: A class is a blueprint; an object is something built from it. A class holds properties (data) and methods (functions). `private` hides data from outside, the constructor sets up a new object, and `extends` lets one class reuse another.
answer.fr: Une classe est un plan ; un objet est ce qu'on construit à partir de lui. Une classe contient des propriétés (données) et des méthodes (fonctions). `private` cache les données de l'extérieur, le constructeur initialise un nouvel objet et `extends` permet à une classe d'en réutiliser une autre.
answer.rw: Class ni igishushanyo mbonera; object ni ikintu cyubatswe kuri cyo. Class ifite properties (amakuru) na methods (functions). `private` ihisha amakuru hanze, constructor itegura object nshya, naho `extends` ituma class imwe ikoresha indi.
answer.sw: Class ni mchoro; object ni kitu kilichojengwa kutoka kwake. Class ina properties (data) na methods (functions). `private` huficha data kutoka nje, constructor huandaa object mpya, na `extends` huruhusu class moja kutumia nyingine.

en: `class Student { private string $name; public function __construct(string $name) { $this->name = $name; } public function hello() { return "Hi " . $this->name; } }`
Create: `$s = new Student("Aline"); echo $s->hello();` prints `Hi Aline`.
Inherit: `class Teacher extends Student { }` reuses the same properties and methods.
`$this` means 'this object'; `->` reaches its properties and methods.
fr: `class Student { private string $name; public function __construct(string $name) { $this->name = $name; } public function hello() { return "Hi " . $this->name; } }`
Créer : `$s = new Student("Aline"); echo $s->hello();` affiche `Hi Aline`.
Hériter : `class Teacher extends Student { }` réutilise les mêmes propriétés et méthodes.
`$this` signifie « cet objet » ; `->` accède à ses propriétés et méthodes.
rw: `class Student { private string $name; public function __construct(string $name) { $this->name = $name; } public function hello() { return "Hi " . $this->name; } }`
Kurema: `$s = new Student("Aline"); echo $s->hello();` yerekana `Hi Aline`.
Kuragwa: `class Teacher extends Student { }` ikoresha properties na methods bimwe.
`$this` bivuga «iyi object»; `->` igera kuri properties na methods zayo.
sw: `class Student { private string $name; public function __construct(string $name) { $this->name = $name; } public function hello() { return "Hi " . $this->name; } }`
Unda: `$s = new Student("Aline"); echo $s->hello();` huchapisha `Hi Aline`.
Kurithi: `class Teacher extends Student { }` hutumia properties na methods zilezile.
`$this` humaanisha 'object hii'; `->` hufikia properties na methods zake.

title.en: What is JSON and how do I use it in JavaScript?
title.fr: Qu'est-ce que JSON et comment l'utiliser en JavaScript ?
title.rw: JSON ni iki kandi nyikoresha nte muri JavaScript?
title.sw: JSON ni nini na nitumieje katika JavaScript?

answer.en: JSON is a text format for sending data, written like a JavaScript object but with double-quoted keys. `JSON.parse()` turns JSON text into an object, and `JSON.stringify()` turns an object into JSON text.
answer.fr: JSON est un format texte pour échanger des données, écrit comme un objet JavaScript mais avec des clés entre guillemets doubles. `JSON.parse()` transforme le texte JSON en objet et `JSON.stringify()` transforme un objet en texte JSON.
answer.rw: JSON ni imiterere y'inyandiko yo kohereza amakuru, yanditse nka object ya JavaScript ariko ifite keys mu nyuguti zibiri z'amagambo. `JSON.parse()` ihindura inyandiko ya JSON object, naho `JSON.stringify()` ikayihindura inyandiko ya JSON.
answer.sw: JSON ni muundo wa maandishi wa kutuma data, ulioandikwa kama object ya JavaScript lakini na funguo ndani ya nukuu mbili. `JSON.parse()` hubadilisha maandishi ya JSON kuwa object, na `JSON.stringify()` hubadilisha object kuwa maandishi ya JSON.

en: Back to object: `const obj = JSON.parse(text); console.log(obj.age);` → 21
Wrap `JSON.parse` in `try/catch`: invalid text throws an error.
fr: Retour en objet : `const obj = JSON.parse(text); console.log(obj.age);` → 21
Entourez `JSON.parse` d'un `try/catch` : un texte invalide lève une erreur.
rw: Gusubira kuri object: `const obj = JSON.parse(text); console.log(obj.age);` → 21
Shyira `JSON.parse` muri `try/catch`: inyandiko itemewe itera ikosa.
sw: Kurudi kuwa object: `const obj = JSON.parse(text); console.log(obj.age);` → 21
Weka `JSON.parse` ndani ya `try/catch`: maandishi batili hutoa hitilafu.

title.en: What is the active and passive voice in English?
title.fr: Qu'est-ce que la voix active et passive en anglais ?
title.rw: Active na passive voice mu cyongereza ni iki?
title.sw: Active na passive voice katika Kiingereza ni nini?

answer.en: In the active voice the subject does the action (`The farmer sold the maize`). In the passive voice the object becomes the subject (`The maize was sold by the farmer`). Form it with the verb `to be` + past participle.
answer.fr: À la voix active le sujet fait l'action (`The farmer sold the maize`). À la voix passive l'objet devient le sujet (`The maize was sold by the farmer`). On la forme avec le verbe `to be` + participe passé.
answer.rw: Muri active voice nyir'igikorwa niwe ukora (`The farmer sold the maize`). Muri passive voice object iba subject (`The maize was sold by the farmer`). Ikorwa na verb `to be` + past participle.
answer.sw: Katika active voice mtenda hufanya kitendo (`The farmer sold the maize`). Katika passive voice kitendwa huwa mtenda (`The maize was sold by the farmer`). Hujengwa kwa kitenzi `to be` + past participle.

en: Present: `The letter is written.` Past: `The letter was written.` Future: `The letter will be written.`
Active → passive: `Aline cooked dinner.` → `Dinner was cooked by Aline.`
Steps: move the object to the front, use `to be` in the same tense, then the past participle.
Use passive when the doer is unknown or unimportant: `My phone was stolen.`
fr: Présent : `The letter is written.` Passé : `The letter was written.` Futur : `The letter will be written.`
Actif → passif : `Aline cooked dinner.` → `Dinner was cooked by Aline.`
Étapes : mettre l'objet en tête, `to be` au même temps, puis le participe passé.
Utilisez le passif quand l'auteur est inconnu ou sans importance : `My phone was stolen.`
rw: Ubu: `The letter is written.` Ahahise: `The letter was written.` Ejo hazaza: `The letter will be written.`
Active → passive: `Aline cooked dinner.` → `Dinner was cooked by Aline.`
Intambwe: shyira object imbere, ukoreshe `to be` mu gihe kimwe, hanyuma past participle.
Koresha passive iyo ukora atazwi cyangwa nta cyo bivuze: `My phone was stolen.`
sw: Sasa: `The letter is written.` Uliopita: `The letter was written.` Ujao: `The letter will be written.`
Active → passive: `Aline cooked dinner.` → `Dinner was cooked by Aline.`
Hatua: weka kitendwa mbele, tumia `to be` katika wakati uleule, kisha past participle.
Tumia passive mtendaji asipojulikana au hana umuhimu: `My phone was stolen.`

title.en: How do I write a good essay or paragraph?
title.fr: Comment écrire une bonne dissertation ou un bon paragraphe ?
title.rw: Nandika nte inyandiko nziza (essay) cyangwa paragarafu?
title.sw: Ninaandikaje insha au aya nzuri?

answer.en: A good essay has three parts: an introduction that states your main point, body paragraphs that each develop one idea with evidence, and a conclusion that sums up. Plan first, write second, then edit.
answer.fr: Une bonne dissertation a trois parties : une introduction qui énonce l'idée principale, des paragraphes de développement qui traitent chacun une idée avec des preuves, et une conclusion qui résume. Planifiez d'abord, rédigez ensuite, puis relisez.
answer.rw: Essay nziza ifite ibice bitatu: intangiriro ivuga igitekerezo nyamukuru, ibika by'umubiri buri kimwe gisobanura igitekerezo kimwe gifite ibimenyetso, n'umusozo ukusanya ibyavuzwe. Banza utegure, wandike, hanyuma ukosore.
answer.sw: Insha nzuri ina sehemu tatu: utangulizi unaotaja hoja kuu, aya za kiini kila moja ikieleza wazo moja kwa ushahidi, na hitimisho linalofupisha. Panga kwanza, andika, kisha hariri.

en: Introduction: a hook, a short background, and your main point (thesis) in one sentence.
Each body paragraph: topic sentence → explanation → example or evidence → link back to the thesis.
Conclusion: restate the thesis in new words and end with a final thought; add no new arguments.
Edit: read aloud, cut repeated words, check spelling and punctuation.
fr: Introduction : une accroche, un bref contexte et l'idée principale (thèse) en une phrase.
Chaque paragraphe : phrase d'idée → explication → exemple ou preuve → lien avec la thèse.
Conclusion : reformulez la thèse avec d'autres mots et finissez par une réflexion ; pas de nouveaux arguments.
Relecture : lisez à voix haute, supprimez les répétitions, vérifiez orthographe et ponctuation.
rw: Intangiriro: ikintu gikurura, amavu n'amavuko magufi, n'igitekerezo nyamukuru (thesis) mu nteruro imwe.
Buri paragarafu: topic sentence → ibisobanuro → urugero cyangwa ibimenyetso → guhuza na thesis.
Umusozo: subiramo thesis mu yandi magambo urangize utekereza; ntushyiremo impaka nshya.
Gukosora: soma n'ijwi, kuramo amagambo asubiramo, ugenzure imyandikire n'ibimenyetso.
sw: Utangulizi: kivutio, usuli mfupi, na hoja kuu (thesis) katika sentensi moja.
Kila aya: sentensi kuu → maelezo → mfano au ushahidi → kuunganisha na thesis.
Hitimisho: rudia thesis kwa maneno mapya na umalize kwa wazo; usiweke hoja mpya.
Kuhariri: soma kwa sauti, ondoa maneno yanayorudiwa, hakiki tahajia na alama za uandishi.

title.en: What is the difference between TCP and UDP?
title.fr: Quelle différence entre TCP et UDP ?
title.rw: Itandukaniro rya TCP na UDP ni irihe?
title.sw: Tofauti ya TCP na UDP ni ipi?

answer.en: TCP is reliable: it sets up a connection, numbers the data, and resends anything lost, so web pages, email and file transfers use it. UDP is fast but does not check delivery, so video calls, live streaming, games and DNS use it. A port number tells the computer which program should receive the data.
answer.fr: TCP est fiable : il établit une connexion, numérote les données et renvoie ce qui est perdu, donc pages web, e-mail et transferts de fichiers l'utilisent. UDP est rapide mais ne vérifie pas la livraison, donc appels vidéo, streaming en direct, jeux et DNS l'utilisent. Un numéro de port indique au système quel programme doit recevoir les données.
answer.rw: TCP irizewe: ikora uguhuza, ikabara amakuru, ikongera kohereza ibyabuze, bityo impapuro z'urubuga, imeri n'ohereza ry'amadosiye biyikoresha. UDP ni yihuta ariko ntigenzura ko amakuru yagezeyo, bityo video calls, live streaming, imikino na DNS biyikoresha. Nimero ya port ibwira mudasobwa porogaramu igomba kwakira amakuru.
answer.sw: TCP ni ya kuaminika: huunda muunganisho, huhesabu data, na kutuma tena kilichopotea, hivyo kurasa za wavuti, barua pepe na uhamishaji wa faili hutumia. UDP ni haraka lakini haikagui uwasilishaji, hivyo simu za video, utiririshaji wa moja kwa moja, michezo na DNS hutumia. Namba ya port huambia kompyuta programu ipi ipokee data.

en: TCP starts with a three-way handshake: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK.
Common ports: 80 HTTP, 443 HTTPS, 53 DNS, 22 SSH, 25 email sending.
Choose TCP when every byte must arrive; choose UDP when speed matters more than a lost packet.
See open connections on your computer with `netstat -an`.
fr: TCP commence par une poignée de main en trois temps : SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK.
Ports courants : 80 HTTP, 443 HTTPS, 53 DNS, 22 SSH, 25 envoi d'e-mail.
Choisissez TCP quand chaque octet doit arriver ; UDP quand la vitesse compte plus qu'un paquet perdu.
rw: TCP itangirana na three-way handshake: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK.
Ports zisanzwe: 80 HTTP, 443 HTTPS, 53 DNS, 22 SSH, 25 kohereza imeri.
Hitamo TCP iyo buri byte igomba kugera; hitamo UDP iyo umuvuduko uruta paquet imwe yabuze.
Reba uguhuza kuri mudasobwa yawe ukoresheje `netstat -an`.
sw: TCP huanza na three-way handshake: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK.
Port za kawaida: 80 HTTP, 443 HTTPS, 53 DNS, 22 SSH, 25 kutuma barua pepe.
Chagua TCP kila byte inapohitaji kufika; chagua UDP kasi inapozidi umuhimu wa pakiti moja iliyopotea.
Ona miunganisho wazi kwenye kompyuta yako kwa `netstat -an`.

title.en: What are a firewall and a VPN, and what do they do?
title.fr: Que sont un pare-feu et un VPN, et à quoi servent-ils ?
title.rw: Firewall na VPN ni iki kandi bikora iki?
title.sw: Firewall na VPN ni nini na hufanya nini?

answer.en: A firewall filters network traffic by rules, blocking connections that should not get in or out. A VPN encrypts your traffic and sends it through another server, which protects you on untrusted networks and hides your address from the sites you visit. A VPN does not make you anonymous and does not stop scams or malware.
answer.fr: Un pare-feu filtre le trafic réseau selon des règles et bloque les connexions indésirables. Un VPN chiffre votre trafic et le fait passer par un autre serveur, ce qui vous protège sur les réseaux peu sûrs et cache votre adresse aux sites visités. Un VPN ne vous rend pas anonyme et n'arrête ni les arnaques ni les logiciels malveillants.
answer.rw: Firewall isuzuma urujya n'uruza rwa network ikoresheje amategeko, igahagarika uguhuza kudakwiye. VPN ishyira traffic yawe mu ibanga ikayinyuza kuri seriveri indi, bikakurinda ku miyoboro idakemewe kandi bigahisha aderesi yawe ku mbuga usura. VPN ntikugira utamenyekana kandi ntihagarika uburiganya cyangwa malware.
answer.sw: Firewall huchuja trafiki ya mtandao kwa sheria, ikizuia miunganisho isiyofaa. VPN husimba trafiki yako na kuipitisha kwenye seva nyingine, kukulinda kwenye mitandao isiyoaminika na kuficha anwani yako kwa tovuti unazotembelea. VPN haikufanyi usijulikane wala haizuii utapeli au programu hasidi.

en: Keep your device firewall on (Windows Defender Firewall, or `ufw enable` on Linux).
Use a VPN on public Wi-Fi, from a provider you have checked; free VPNs may sell your data.
A router firewall protects every device at home; change the router's default admin password.
A firewall and antivirus do different jobs: use both, and keep the system updated.
fr: Gardez le pare-feu de l'appareil activé (Pare-feu Windows, ou `ufw enable` sous Linux).
Utilisez un VPN sur Wi-Fi public, auprès d'un fournisseur vérifié ; les VPN gratuits peuvent vendre vos données.
Le pare-feu du routeur protège tous les appareils de la maison ; changez le mot de passe admin par défaut.
Pare-feu et antivirus font des tâches différentes : utilisez les deux et mettez le système à jour.
rw: Komeza firewall y'igikoresho ifunguye (Windows Defender Firewall, cyangwa `ufw enable` kuri Linux).
Koresha VPN kuri Wi-Fi rusange, y'utanga serivisi wagenzuye; VPN z'ubuntu zishobora kugurisha amakuru yawe.
Firewall ya router irinda ibikoresho byose byo mu rugo; hindura ijambo ry'ibanga risanzwe rya admin.
Firewall na antivirus bikora imirimo itandukanye: koresha byombi, kandi ukomeze ivugurura rya sisitemu.
sw: Weka firewall ya kifaa ikiwa imewashwa (Windows Defender Firewall, au `ufw enable` kwenye Linux).
Tumia VPN kwenye Wi-Fi ya umma, kutoka kwa mtoa huduma uliyemhakiki; VPN za bure zinaweza kuuza data yako.
Firewall ya router hulinda vifaa vyote nyumbani; badilisha nenosiri-msingi la admin la router.
Firewall na antivirus hufanya kazi tofauti: tumia zote mbili, na usasishe mfumo.

title.en: How much exercise do I need and how do I start?
title.fr: De combien d'exercice ai-je besoin et comment commencer ?
title.rw: Nkeneye imyitozo ingana iki kandi natangira nte?
title.sw: Ninahitaji mazoezi kiasi gani na nianzeje?

answer.en: Health guidance for adults suggests about 150 minutes a week of moderate activity (such as brisk walking), plus muscle-strengthening on two days. Start small, build slowly, and choose something you enjoy so you keep doing it.
answer.fr: Les recommandations de santé pour les adultes suggèrent environ 150 minutes par semaine d'activité modérée (comme la marche rapide), plus du renforcement musculaire deux jours. Commencez petit, progressez lentement et choisissez une activité que vous aimez pour tenir dans la durée.
answer.rw: Inama z'ubuzima ku bantu bakuru zivuga nk'iminota 150 mu cyumweru y'imyitozo ihagije (nko kugenda vuba), n'imyitozo y'imikaya iminsi ibiri. Tangira gake, wiyongere buhoro, kandi uhitemo icyo ukunda kugira ngo ukomeze.
answer.sw: Miongozo ya afya kwa watu wazima inapendekeza takriban dakika 150 kwa wiki za mazoezi ya wastani (kama kutembea haraka), pamoja na kuimarisha misuli siku mbili. Anza kidogo, ongeza polepole, na uchague unachopenda ili uendelee.

en: Week 1: walk briskly 15 minutes, 3 days. Add 5 minutes each week.
Bodyweight strength at home: squats, push-ups (on knees if needed), planks, 2 sets of 8–12.
Warm up for 5 minutes first and stretch afterwards; stop if you feel sharp pain.
If you have a heart condition, are pregnant, or have been inactive for years with health problems, speak to a health worker before starting.
fr: Semaine 1 : marche rapide 15 minutes, 3 jours. Ajoutez 5 minutes chaque semaine.
Renforcement à la maison : squats, pompes (sur les genoux si besoin), planche, 2 séries de 8 à 12.
Échauffez-vous 5 minutes et étirez-vous après ; arrêtez en cas de douleur vive.
Si vous avez un problème cardiaque, êtes enceinte, ou inactif depuis des années avec des soucis de santé, parlez à un professionnel de santé avant de commencer.
rw: Icyumweru 1: kugenda vuba iminota 15, iminsi 3. Ongeraho iminota 5 buri cyumweru.
Imyitozo y'imikaya mu rugo: squats, push-ups (ku maguru niba bibaye ngombwa), planks, seti 2 za 8–12.
Banza ushyuhe iminota 5 kandi wikure nyuma; hagarara niba wumvise ububabare bukaze.
Niba ufite ikibazo cy'umutima, utwite, cyangwa umaze imyaka utakora imyitozo ufite ibibazo by'ubuzima, vugana n'umuganga mbere yo gutangira.
sw: Wiki 1: tembea haraka dakika 15, siku 3. Ongeza dakika 5 kila wiki.
Nguvu nyumbani: squats, push-ups (kwa magoti ukihitaji), planks, seti 2 za 8–12.
Pasha mwili joto dakika 5 na unyooshe baadaye; acha ukihisi maumivu makali.
Ikiwa una tatizo la moyo, ni mjamzito, au hujafanya mazoezi kwa miaka na una matatizo ya kiafya, zungumza na mhudumu wa afya kabla ya kuanza.

title.en: What is the Big Bang and how did the universe begin?
title.fr: Qu'est-ce que le Big Bang et comment l'univers a-t-il commencé ?
title.rw: Big Bang ni iki kandi isanzure ryatangiye rite?
title.sw: Big Bang ni nini na ulimwengu ulianzaje?

answer.en: The Big Bang theory says the universe began about 13.8 billion years ago from an extremely hot, dense state and has been expanding and cooling ever since. It was not an explosion in space; space itself expanded. Evidence includes the expansion of galaxies, the cosmic microwave background (leftover light), and the amounts of hydrogen and helium.
answer.fr: La théorie du Big Bang dit que l'univers a commencé il y a environ 13,8 milliards d'années à partir d'un état extrêmement chaud et dense, et qu'il se dilate et se refroidit depuis. Ce n'était pas une explosion dans l'espace ; c'est l'espace lui-même qui s'est dilaté. Les preuves : l'expansion des galaxies, le fond diffus cosmologique (lumière fossile) et les proportions d'hydrogène et d'hélium.
answer.rw: Theory ya Big Bang ivuga ko isanzure ryatangiye hashize imyaka miliyari 13.8 riva ku mimerere ishyushye cyane kandi ifunganye, kuva icyo gihe riragenda ryaguka rigakonja. Ntabwo ari iturika mu cyogajuru; ahubwo umwanya ubwawo warazamutse. Ibimenyetso: kwaguka kw'ibyogajuru by'inyenyeri (galaxies), urumuri rusigaye (CMB), n'ingano ya hydrogen na helium.
answer.sw: Nadharia ya Big Bang inasema ulimwengu ulianza takriban miaka bilioni 13.8 iliyopita kutoka hali yenye joto kali na msongamano mkubwa, na tangu hapo unapanuka na kupoa. Haikuwa mlipuko angani; nafasi yenyewe ilipanuka. Ushahidi: kupanuka kwa galaksi, mwanga uliobaki (CMB), na kiasi cha hidrojeni na heliamu.

en: About 13.8 billion years ago: the Big Bang; within minutes the first hydrogen and helium nuclei formed.
About 380,000 years later: atoms formed and light could travel freely; we still detect it as the cosmic microwave background.
A few hundred million years later: the first stars and galaxies formed.
Science cannot yet say what, if anything, came before the Big Bang; that is an open question.
fr: Il y a environ 13,8 milliards d'années : le Big Bang ; en quelques minutes, les premiers noyaux d'hydrogène et d'hélium se forment.
Environ 380 000 ans plus tard : les atomes se forment et la lumière circule librement ; on la détecte encore comme fond diffus cosmologique.
Quelques centaines de millions d'années plus tard : les premières étoiles et galaxies.
La science ne peut pas encore dire ce qu'il y avait avant le Big Bang, s'il y avait quelque chose ; la question reste ouverte.
rw: Hashize imyaka miliyari 13.8: Big Bang; mu minota mike hakozwe nuclei za mbere za hydrogen na helium.
Nyuma y'imyaka nka 380,000: atomes zarakozwe urumuri rutangira kugenda; turacyarubona nka CMB.
Nyuma y'imyaka miliyoni magana make: inyenyeri za mbere na galaxies byaravutse.
Siyansi ntiramenya ibyabanje mbere ya Big Bang, niba hari ibyabayeho; ni ikibazo kikiri gifunguye.
sw: Takriban miaka bilioni 13.8 iliyopita: Big Bang; ndani ya dakika chache viini vya kwanza vya hidrojeni na heliamu viliundwa.
Takriban miaka 380,000 baadaye: atomu ziliundwa na mwanga ukaanza kusafiri; bado tunauona kama CMB.
Mamia ya mamilioni ya miaka baadaye: nyota na galaksi za kwanza ziliundwa.
Sayansi bado haiwezi kusema kilikuwepo nini kabla ya Big Bang, kama kilikuwepo; swali hilo bado liko wazi.

title.en: What is a galaxy and is the universe expanding? (dark matter, dark energy)
title.fr: Qu'est-ce qu'une galaxie et l'univers est-il en expansion ? (matière noire, énergie noire)
title.rw: Galaxy ni iki kandi isanzure riraguka? (dark matter, dark energy)
title.sw: Galaksi ni nini na ulimwengu unapanuka? (dark matter, dark energy)

answer.en: A galaxy is a huge system of stars, gas, dust and dark matter held together by gravity. Our galaxy is the Milky Way. In 1929 Edwin Hubble showed that distant galaxies move away from us, and the farther they are the faster they recede, which means space is expanding. The expansion is speeding up, which scientists attribute to dark energy.
answer.fr: Une galaxie est un immense ensemble d'étoiles, de gaz, de poussière et de matière noire maintenu par la gravité. La nôtre est la Voie lactée. En 1929, Edwin Hubble a montré que les galaxies lointaines s'éloignent de nous, d'autant plus vite qu'elles sont loin : l'espace est en expansion. Cette expansion s'accélère, ce que les scientifiques attribuent à l'énergie noire.
