Cheche ilikuwa kuuawa kwa Archduke Franz Ferdinand Sarajevo 28 Juni 1914, lakini sababu za kina ni ujeshi, miungano, ushindani wa kikoloni na utaifa. Takriban wanajeshi milioni 9–10 na mamilioni ya raia walikufa.

en: Ended with the armistice on 11 November 1918; the Treaty of Versailles (1919) blamed Germany and imposed reparations.
New technology: machine guns, poison gas, tanks, aircraft, submarines; trench warfare caused long stalemates.
Four empires collapsed: German, Austro-Hungarian, Russian and Ottoman.
The League of Nations was created to keep peace but failed to prevent World War II; German resentment of Versailles contributed to the rise of the Nazis.
fr: Fin avec l'armistice du 11 novembre 1918 ; le traité de Versailles (1919) rendit l'Allemagne responsable et imposa des réparations.
Nouvelles techniques : mitrailleuses, gaz toxiques, chars, avions, sous-marins ; la guerre de tranchées causa de longues impasses.
Quatre empires s'effondrèrent : allemand, austro-hongrois, russe et ottoman.
La Société des Nations fut créée pour garantir la paix mais n'a pas empêché la Seconde Guerre ; le ressentiment allemand envers Versailles a favorisé la montée des nazis.
rw: Yarangiye n'agahenge ku wa 11 Ugushyingo 1918; Treaty of Versailles (1919) yashinje Ubudage ishyiraho indishyi.
Ikoranabuhanga rishya: imbunda zihuta, imyuka y'ubumara, tanks, indege, ubwato bwo mu mazi; trench warfare yateje guhagarara igihe kirekire.
Ubwami bune bwarasenyutse: Ubudage, Autriche-Hongrie, Uburusiya n'Abottoman.
League of Nations yashyizweho kurinda amahoro ariko ntiyabujije Intambara ya kabiri; uburakari bw'Abadage kuri Versailles bwagize uruhare mu izamuka rya Nazi.
sw: Viliisha kwa mkataba wa kusitisha mapigano 11 Novemba 1918; Mkataba wa Versailles (1919) uliilaumu Ujerumani na kuweka fidia.
Teknolojia mpya: bunduki za rashasha, gesi ya sumu, vifaru, ndege, manowari; vita vya mahandaki vilileta mkwamo mrefu.
Himaya nne zilianguka: Ujerumani, Austria-Hungary, Urusi na Ottoman.
Ligi ya Mataifa iliundwa kulinda amani lakini haikuzuia Vita vya Pili; chuki ya Wajerumani kwa Versailles ilichangia kupanda kwa Nazi.

title.en: What was World War II (causes, key events, how it ended)?
title.fr: Qu'était la Seconde Guerre mondiale (causes, événements clés, fin) ?
title.rw: Intambara ya kabiri y'isi yari iki (impamvu, ibyabaye, uko yarangiye)?
title.sw: Vita vya Pili vya Dunia vilikuwa nini (sababu, matukio, jinsi viliisha)?

fr: causes de la seconde guerre mondiale
sw: sababu za vita vya pili vya dunia

answer.en: World War II (1939–1945) was the deadliest war in history, with an estimated 70–85 million deaths. It began on 1 September 1939 when Nazi Germany under Adolf Hitler invaded Poland. It was fought between the Allies (Britain, the Soviet Union, the USA, China, France and others) and the Axis (Germany, Italy, Japan). Causes included the Treaty of Versailles, the Great Depression, aggressive nationalism and the failure of appeasement.
answer.fr: La Seconde Guerre mondiale (1939–1945) fut la guerre la plus meurtrière de l'histoire, avec environ 70 à 85 millions de morts. Elle a commencé le 1er septembre 1939 quand l'Allemagne nazie d'Adolf Hitler a envahi la Pologne. Elle opposa les Alliés (Royaume-Uni, URSS, États-Unis, Chine, France et autres) à l'Axe (Allemagne, Italie, Japon). Causes : traité de Versailles, Grande Dépression, nationalisme agressif, échec de l'apaisement.
answer.rw: Intambara ya kabiri y'isi (1939–1945) niyo yishe abantu benshi mu mateka, abagera kuri miliyoni 70–85. Yatangiye ku wa 1 Nzeri 1939 ubwo Ubudage bwa Nazi bwa Adolf Hitler bwateraga Pologne. Yarwanywe hagati y'Allies (Ubwongereza, USSR, USA, Ubushinwa, u Bufaransa n'abandi) n'Axis (Ubudage, u Butaliyani, Ubuyapani). Impamvu: Treaty of Versailles, Great Depression, nationalism y'ubukana no gutsindwa kwa appeasement.
answer.sw: Vita vya Pili vya Dunia (1939–1945) vilikuwa vita vilivyoua zaidi katika historia, takriban vifo milioni 70–85. Vilianza 1 Septemba 1939 Ujerumani ya Nazi chini ya Adolf Hitler ilipovamia Poland. Vilipiganwa kati ya Washirika (Uingereza, USSR, Marekani, China, Ufaransa na wengine) na Axis (Ujerumani, Italia, Japani). Sababu: Mkataba wa Versailles, Mdororo Mkuu, utaifa mkali na kushindwa kwa appeasement.

en: The Holocaust: Nazi Germany and its collaborators murdered about six million Jews and millions of others (Roma, disabled people, political prisoners).
Turning points: Battle of Stalingrad (1942–43), D-Day landings in Normandy (6 June 1944), Soviet advance to Berlin.
Germany surrendered on 8 May 1945; the US dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima (6 August) and Nagasaki (9 August); Japan surrendered on 2 September 1945.
Aftermath: the United Nations (1945), decolonisation, the Cold War and the division of Europe.
fr: L'Holocauste : l'Allemagne nazie et ses collaborateurs ont assassiné environ six millions de Juifs et des millions d'autres personnes (Roms, handicapés, prisonniers politiques).
Tournants : bataille de Stalingrad (1942–43), débarquement de Normandie (6 juin 1944), avancée soviétique vers Berlin.
L'Allemagne capitula le 8 mai 1945 ; les États-Unis larguèrent des bombes atomiques sur Hiroshima (6 août) et Nagasaki (9 août) ; le Japon capitula le 2 septembre 1945.
Suites : ONU (1945), décolonisation, guerre froide et division de l'Europe.
rw: Holocaust: Ubudage bwa Nazi n'abafatanyije nabwo bishe Abayahudi nka miliyoni esheshatu na miliyoni z'abandi (Roma, abafite ubumuga, imfungwa za politiki).
Ibihe by'impinduka: Intambara ya Stalingrad (1942–43), D-Day muri Normandy (6 Kamena 1944), Abasoviyeti bagana i Berlin.
Ubudage bwarishyize ku wa 8 Gicurasi 1945; USA yajugunye bombe za atomique kuri Hiroshima (6 Kanama) na Nagasaki (9 Kanama); Ubuyapani bwishyize ku wa 2 Nzeri 1945.
Ingaruka: UN (1945), decolonisation, Cold War no kugabana kw'u Burayi.
sw: Holocaust: Ujerumani ya Nazi na washirika wake waliua takriban Wayahudi milioni sita na mamilioni ya wengine (Roma, walemavu, wafungwa wa kisiasa).
Mabadiliko makuu: Vita vya Stalingrad (1942–43), kutua Normandy D-Day (6 Juni 1944), Wasovieti kuelekea Berlin.
Ujerumani ilijisalimisha 8 Mei 1945; Marekani ilidondosha mabomu ya atomiki Hiroshima (6 Agosti) na Nagasaki (9 Agosti); Japani ilijisalimisha 2 Septemba 1945.
Matokeo: Umoja wa Mataifa (1945), kuondoa ukoloni, Vita Baridi na kugawanywa kwa Ulaya.

title.en: What was the Cold War?
title.fr: Qu'était la guerre froide ?
title.rw: Cold War yari iki?
title.sw: Vita Baridi vilikuwa nini?

answer.en: The Cold War (about 1947–1991) was a long rivalry between the United States (capitalist democracy, NATO) and the Soviet Union (communist, Warsaw Pact) that never became direct war between them. They competed through arms, spies, propaganda, the space race and 'proxy wars' such as Korea (1950–53) and Vietnam. The Cuban Missile Crisis (1962) was the closest the world came to nuclear war.
answer.fr: La guerre froide (environ 1947–1991) fut une longue rivalité entre les États-Unis (démocratie capitaliste, OTAN) et l'Union soviétique (communiste, pacte de Varsovie), qui ne dégénéra jamais en guerre directe entre eux. Ils se sont affrontés par les armements, l'espionnage, la propagande, la course à l'espace et des « guerres par procuration » comme la Corée (1950–53) et le Vietnam. La crise des missiles de Cuba (1962) fut le moment le plus proche d'une guerre nucléaire.
answer.rw: Cold War (nka 1947–1991) yari ihangana rirerire hagati ya USA (demokarasi ya capitalist, NATO) na Soviet Union (communist, Warsaw Pact) ritigeze rihinduka intambara itaziguye hagati yabo. Bahanganye mu ntwaro, ubutasi, propaganda, space race n'intambara zihagarariwe nka Koreya (1950–53) na Vietnam. Cuban Missile Crisis (1962) niyo yegereye cyane intambara ya nucléaire.
answer.sw: Vita Baridi (takriban 1947–1991) vilikuwa ushindani mrefu kati ya Marekani (demokrasia ya kibepari, NATO) na Umoja wa Kisovieti (ukomunisti, Warsaw Pact) ambao haukuwa vita vya moja kwa moja kati yao. Walishindana kwa silaha, ujasusi, propaganda, mbio za anga na 'vita vya wakala' kama Korea (1950–53) na Vietnam. Mgogoro wa Makombora ya Cuba (1962) ulikuwa karibu zaidi na vita vya nyuklia.

en: Berlin was divided; the Berlin Wall stood from 1961 to 1989, and its fall (9 November 1989) symbolised the end of the division.
Space race: Sputnik (1957), Yuri Gagarin first human in space (1961), Apollo 11 Moon landing (1969).
Many African and Asian countries became Cold War battlegrounds; the Non-Aligned Movement tried to stay neutral.
Germany reunified in 1990 and the Soviet Union dissolved in December 1991, ending the Cold War.
fr: Berlin fut divisée ; le mur de Berlin exista de 1961 à 1989, et sa chute (9 novembre 1989) symbolisa la fin de la division.
Course à l'espace : Spoutnik (1957), Youri Gagarine premier humain dans l'espace (1961), alunissage d'Apollo 11 (1969).
De nombreux pays africains et asiatiques devinrent des terrains d'affrontement ; le Mouvement des non-alignés tenta de rester neutre.
L'Allemagne se réunifia en 1990 et l'Union soviétique se dissout en décembre 1991, mettant fin à la guerre froide.
rw: Berlin yacitsemo kabiri; Urukuta rwa Berlin rwabayeho 1961–1989, kugwa kwarwo (9 Ugushyingo 1989) byerekanye iherezo ry'ubwo bwigunge.
Space race: Sputnik (1957), Yuri Gagarin umuntu wa mbere mu cyogajuru (1961), Apollo 11 ku kwezi (1969).
Ibihugu byinshi bya Afurika na Aziya byabaye ahantu h'imirwano; Non-Aligned Movement yagerageje kutabogamira.
Ubudage bwongeye guhurira mu 1990 maze Soviet Union isenyuka mu Kuboza 1991, birangiza Cold War.
sw: Berlin iligawanywa; Ukuta wa Berlin ulisimama 1961–1989, kuanguka kwake (9 Novemba 1989) kuliashiria mwisho wa mgawanyiko.
Mbio za anga: Sputnik (1957), Yuri Gagarin binadamu wa kwanza angani (1961), Apollo 11 mwezini (1969).
Nchi nyingi za Afrika na Asia zikawa uwanja wa mapambano; Harakati ya Kutofungamana ilijaribu kubaki upande wowote.
Ujerumani iliungana 1990 na Umoja wa Kisovieti ulivunjika Desemba 1991, ukimaliza Vita Baridi.

title.en: What is the history of Rwanda? (kingdom, colonial period, 1994 genocide against the Tutsi, today)
title.fr: Quelle est l'histoire du Rwanda ? (royaume, colonisation, génocide contre les Tutsi de 1994, aujourd'hui)
title.rw: Amateka y'u Rwanda ni ayahe? (ubwami, ubukoloni, jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi 1994, uyu munsi)
title.sw: Historia ya Rwanda ni ipi? (ufalme, ukoloni, mauaji ya halaiki dhidi ya Watutsi 1994, leo)

sw: mauaji ya halaiki dhidi ya watutsi

answer.en: Rwanda was a centralised kingdom for centuries, ruled by a mwami and unified by Kinyarwanda language and culture. It was colonised by Germany (from about 1897) and, after World War I, administered by Belgium, which hardened ethnic identity cards that divided Hutu, Tutsi and Twa. Rwanda became independent on 1 July 1962. Between 7 April and mid-July 1994, the Genocide against the Tutsi killed at least 800,000 people (estimates range higher); it ended when the Rwandan Patriotic Front took control, on 4 July in Kigali.
answer.fr: Le Rwanda fut pendant des siècles un royaume centralisé, dirigé par un mwami et uni par la langue et la culture kinyarwanda. Il fut colonisé par l'Allemagne (vers 1897) puis, après la Première Guerre mondiale, administré par la Belgique, qui durcit les cartes d'identité ethniques divisant Hutu, Tutsi et Twa. Le Rwanda devint indépendant le 1er juillet 1962. Entre le 7 avril et mi-juillet 1994, le génocide contre les Tutsi a tué au moins 800 000 personnes (des estimations vont plus haut) ; il a pris fin quand le Front patriotique rwandais a pris le contrôle, le 4 juillet à Kigali.
answer.rw: U Rwanda rwari ubwami buhuriweho mu binyejana byinshi, buyobowe n'umwami kandi buhuriye ku rurimi n'umuco by'Ikinyarwanda. Rwakolonijwe n'u Budage (nka 1897) hanyuma, nyuma y'Intambara ya mbere y'isi, ruyoborwa n'u Bubiligi, bwakomeje indangamuntu zishingiye ku moko zigabanya Abahutu, Abatutsi n'Abatwa. U Rwanda rwabonye ubwigenge ku wa 1 Nyakanga 1962. Hagati ya 7 Mata n'impera ya Nyakanga 1994, Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yahitanye nibura abantu 800,000 (ibigereranyo bimwe bivuga benshi kurushaho); yarangiye ubwo Rwandan Patriotic Front yafataga igihugu, ku wa 4 Nyakanga i Kigali.
answer.sw: Rwanda ilikuwa ufalme uliounganishwa kwa karne nyingi, ukiongozwa na mwami na kuunganishwa na lugha na utamaduni wa Kinyarwanda. Ilitawaliwa na Ujerumani (takriban 1897) na, baada ya Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia, kusimamiwa na Ubelgiji, ulioimarisha vitambulisho vya kikabila vilivyogawanya Wahutu, Watutsi na Watwa. Rwanda ilipata uhuru 1 Julai 1962. Kati ya 7 Aprili na katikati ya Julai 1994, Mauaji ya Halaiki dhidi ya Watutsi yaliua angalau watu 800,000 (makadirio mengine ni juu zaidi); yaliisha Rwandan Patriotic Front ilipochukua udhibiti, 4 Julai Kigali.

en: Every year Rwanda commemorates the genocide from 7 April (Kwibuka) with a mourning week and a 100-day remembrance period.
Since 1994 Rwanda has focused on unity and reconciliation, using community 'Gacaca' courts (2002–2012) to try most genocide cases, and has rebuilt its economy and institutions.
Rwanda is known as 'the land of a thousand hills' (Igihugu cy'imisozi igihumbi); Kigali is the capital; official languages include Kinyarwanda, English, French and Kiswahili.
This is a short overview; for details, see the Kigali Genocide Memorial, the Commission for the Fight against Genocide (CNLG) and published historical research.
fr: Chaque année le Rwanda commémore le génocide à partir du 7 avril (Kwibuka), avec une semaine de deuil et 100 jours de souvenir.

Depuis 1994 le Rwanda met l'accent sur l'unité et la réconciliation, avec les tribunaux communautaires « Gacaca » (2002–2012) pour juger la plupart des cas, et a reconstruit son économie et ses institutions.
Le Rwanda est « le pays des mille collines » ; Kigali est la capitale ; les langues officielles incluent le kinyarwanda, l'anglais, le français et le kiswahili.
Ceci est un bref aperçu ; pour plus de détails, voir le Mémorial du génocide de Kigali, la CNLG et les recherches historiques publiées.
rw: Buri mwaka u Rwanda rwibuka jenoside guhera ku wa 7 Mata (Kwibuka), hari icyumweru cy'icyunamo n'iminsi 100 yo kwibuka.
Kuva mu 1994 u Rwanda rwibanze ku bumwe n'ubwiyunge, hakoreshejwe inkiko Gacaca (2002–2012) zakiriye ibyinshi mu manza, kandi rwongeye kubaka ubukungu n'inzego.
U Rwanda ruzwi nk'«Igihugu cy'imisozi igihumbi»; Kigali ni umurwa mukuru; indimi zemewe zirimo Ikinyarwanda, Icyongereza, Igifaransa n'Igiswahili.
Ni incamake; ku makuru arambuye reba Kigali Genocide Memorial, CNLG n'ubushakashatsi bwanditse ku mateka.
sw: Kila mwaka Rwanda huadhimisha mauaji ya halaiki kuanzia 7 Aprili (Kwibuka), kukiwa na wiki ya maombolezo na siku 100 za kumbukumbu.
Tangu 1994 Rwanda imejikita kwenye umoja na maridhiano, ikitumia mahakama za jamii 'Gacaca' (2002–2012) kusikiliza kesi nyingi, na kujenga upya uchumi na taasisi.
Rwanda inajulikana kama 'nchi ya vilima elfu'; Kigali ni mji mkuu; lugha rasmi ni pamoja na Kinyarwanda, Kiingereza, Kifaransa na Kiswahili.
Hii ni muhtasari; kwa maelezo zaidi tazama Kigali Genocide Memorial, CNLG na tafiti za kihistoria zilizochapishwa.

title.en: What was the Digital Revolution and how did the internet begin?
title.fr: Qu'était la révolution numérique et comment Internet est-il né ?
title.rw: Digital Revolution yari iki kandi murandasi yatangiye ite?
title.sw: Mapinduzi ya Kidijitali yalikuwa nini na intaneti ilianzaje?

answer.en: The Digital Revolution is the shift from mechanical and analogue technology to digital electronics and information, beginning in the mid-20th century. The transistor (1947) made small, cheap computers possible. The internet grew from ARPANET (1969), and Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989–91 at CERN, making the internet easy to use for everyone.
answer.fr: La révolution numérique est le passage de la technologie mécanique et analogique à l'électronique et à l'information numériques, à partir du milieu du XXe siècle. Le transistor (1947) a rendu possibles des ordinateurs petits et peu chers. Internet est né d'ARPANET (1969), et Tim Berners-Lee a inventé le World Wide Web en 1989–91 au CERN, rendant Internet facile d'accès pour tous.
answer.rw: Digital Revolution ni impinduka kuva ku ikoranabuhanga ry'imashini na analogue ujya kuri electronics na amakuru ya digitale, zatangiye hagati mu kinyejana cya 20. Transistor (1947) yatumye mudasobwa nto kandi zihendutse zishoboka. Murandasi yavuye muri ARPANET (1969), maze Tim Berners-Lee ahimba World Wide Web mu 1989–91 muri CERN, bituma murandasi yoroha ku bantu bose.
answer.sw: Mapinduzi ya Kidijitali ni mabadiliko kutoka teknolojia ya mitambo na analogi kwenda elektroniki na taarifa za kidijitali, yaliyoanza katikati ya karne ya 20. Transistor (1947) ilifanya kompyuta ndogo na za bei nafuu ziwezekane. Intaneti ilikua kutoka ARPANET (1969), na Tim Berners-Lee alivumbua World Wide Web 1989–91 CERN, akiifanya intaneti iwe rahisi kwa kila mtu.

en: 1940s: first electronic computers (ENIAC, 1945); 1947: transistor; 1958: integrated circuit.
1971: microprocessor; 1970s–80s: personal computers (Apple II 1977, IBM PC 1981).
1983: the internet adopts TCP/IP; 1991: the first website goes public; 1998: Google is founded.
2007: iPhone popularised smartphones; today mobile internet, cloud computing and AI are reshaping work, trade and daily life.
fr: Années 1940 : premiers ordinateurs électroniques (ENIAC, 1945) ; 1947 : transistor ; 1958 : circuit intégré.
1971 : microprocesseur ; années 1970–80 : ordinateurs personnels (Apple II 1977, IBM PC 1981).
1983 : Internet adopte TCP/IP ; 1991 : premier site web public ; 1998 : création de Google.
2007 : l'iPhone popularise les smartphones ; aujourd'hui Internet mobile, cloud et IA transforment le travail, le commerce et la vie quotidienne.
rw: Imyaka ya 1940: mudasobwa za mbere za electronic (ENIAC, 1945); 1947: transistor; 1958: integrated circuit.
1971: microprocessor; 1970–80: mudasobwa bwite (Apple II 1977, IBM PC 1981).
1983: murandasi yemeje TCP/IP; 1991: urubuga rwa mbere rutangazwa; 1998: Google ishingwa.
2007: iPhone yamamaje smartphones; uyu munsi murandasi igendanwa, cloud na AI bihindura akazi, ubucuruzi n'imibereho.
sw: Miaka ya 1940: kompyuta za kwanza za kielektroniki (ENIAC, 1945); 1947: transistor; 1958: saketi jumuishi.
1971: microprocessor; miaka ya 1970–80: kompyuta binafsi (Apple II 1977, IBM PC 1981).
1983: intaneti inapitisha TCP/IP; 1991: tovuti ya kwanza ya umma; 1998: Google inaanzishwa.
2007: iPhone iliwezesha simu janja kuenea; leo intaneti ya simu, wingu na AI vinabadilisha kazi, biashara na maisha ya kila siku.
